en: Everyone always talks about the abusive husband and father. I’ve always kind of been taught that men were always the bad ones. For as long as I can remember I’ve been forced to believe my father was a horrible person. That he was constantly hurting my mom when she was so defenseless. But as I’ve gotten older I’ve been remembering things and finally seeing them for what they really are. The truth is that my father is not a horrible person at all. He is a brilliant and completely selfless person who simply does what he has to do to get by. He’s the type of father every child deserves. I mean, I love my mother, I really do, with all of my heart. I guess that’s why I always took her side for all these years and chose to believe every word she said. But I just can’t take it anymore.
hr: Svi uvijek pričaju o nasilnom mužu i ocu. Oduvijek su me nekako učili da su muškarci uvijek loši. Otkad znam za sebe, bila sam prisiljena vjerovati da je moj otac bio užasna osoba. Da je stalno ozljeđivao moju mamu dok je bila tako bespomoćna. Ali kako sam starila, prisjećala sam se stvari i konačno ih vidjela onakvima kakve jesu. Istina je da moj otac uopće nije užasna osoba. On je briljantna i potpuno nesebična osoba koja jednostavno radi ono što mora da bi se snašla. On je tip oca kakvog svako dijete zaslužuje. Mislim, volim svoju majku, stvarno je volim, svim srcem. Valjda sam zato uvijek bila na njezinoj strani svih ovih godina i odlučila vjerovati svakoj njezinoj riječi. Ali jednostavno više ne mogu podnijeti.
en_back: Everyone always talks about abusive husbands and fathers. I've always been taught that men are always bad. For as long as I can remember, I've been forced to believe that my father was a terrible person. That he constantly hurt my mom while she was so helpless. But as I've gotten older, I've looked back and finally seen things for what they are. The truth is, my father is not a terrible person at all. He's a brilliant and completely selfless person who just does what he has to do to get by. He's the kind of father every child deserves. I mean, I love my mother, I really do, with all my heart. I guess that's why I've always been on her side all these years and chosen to believe every word she says. But I just can't take it anymore.

en: I’ve been attending therapy for several months now and just recently (last three times) my therapist has been coming out about 20 minutes late and often ending early. She never acknowledges it, but a 50-minute session was 20 minutes. Is this an attempt to communicate something? I do struggle with talk therapy; I began going because it’s something you’re supposed to do after a suicide attempt (6 months ago due to amalgamation of MDD, fertility/hormonal issues, eating disorder, job stress, and childhood trauma). I spend a fair amount of time staring at the carpet during appointments because I don’t know what to say. I have been in therapy before, and I did the same thing, so it’s not on her. I feel like I may not have the personality for this to be successful or I’ve made her uncomfortable, but she doesn’t want to push someone seen as vulnerable over the edge, so instead she just turns up late. Is this a thing?
hr: Idem na terapiju već nekoliko mjeseci i nedavno (zadnja tri puta) moja terapeutkinja kasni oko 20 minuta i često završava ranije. Nikad to ne priznaje, ali seansa od 50 minuta trajala je 20 minuta. Je li ovo pokušaj da se nešto komunicira? Mučim se s terapijom razgovorom; počela sam ići jer se to očekuje nakon pokušaja samoubojstva (prije 6 mjeseci zbog kombinacije velikog depresivnog poremećaja, problema s plodnošću/hormonskim problemima, poremećaja prehrane, stresa na poslu i traume iz djetinjstva). Provodim dosta vremena zureći u tepih tijekom termina jer ne znam što bih rekla. Već sam bila na terapiji i učinila sam isto, tako da nije do nje. Osjećam se kao da možda nemam osobnost da bi ovo bilo uspješno ili sam joj dala nelagodu, ali ona ne želi nekoga tko se smatra ranjivim gurati preko ruba, pa umjesto toga jednostavno kasni. Je li to uobičajeno?
en_back: I've been going to therapy for a few months now and recently (the last three times) my therapist has been running about 20 minutes late and often ends early. She never admits it, but a 50 minute session was 20 minutes long. Is this an attempt to communicate something? I struggle with talk therapy; I started going because it's expected after a suicide attempt (6 months ago due to a combination of major depressive disorder, fertility/hormonal issues, eating disorders, work stress, and childhood trauma). I spend a lot of time staring at the carpet during my sessions because I don't know what to say. I've been to therapy before and done the same thing, so it's not her fault. I feel like maybe I don't have the personality to make this work or I've made her uncomfortable, but she doesn't want to push someone who is considered vulnerable over the edge, so instead she just stays late. Is this normal?

en: (I’ve edited this letter down by half) From a 19 year old young man: When I was 12 years old a new teacher came to my school. She was young, approx. 22 years old, and this was her second year of teaching. We clicked from day 1, and over time, we developed a strong, positive student – teacher relationship.. . We began email communication between her and I. At first, they weren’t really anything, just conversations about school, the subject she taught, and things we had in common (which turned out to be a lot).
hr: (Skratio sam ovo pismo za pola) Od 19-godišnjeg mladića: Kad sam imao 12 godina, u moju školu došla je nova učiteljica. Bila je mlada, otprilike 22 godine, i ovo joj je bila druga godina predavanja. Kliknule smo od prvog dana i s vremenom smo razvile snažan, pozitivan odnos učenik-učiteljica... Započele smo komunikaciju putem e-pošte između nje i mene. U početku to nije bilo ništa, samo razgovori o školi, predmetu koji je predavala i stvarima koje smo imale zajedničko (što se pokazalo kao puno).
en_back: (I shortened this letter by half) From a 19-year-old: When I was 12, a new teacher came to my school. She was young, about 22, and this was her second year of teaching. We clicked from day one and over time developed a strong, positive student-teacher relationship... We began communicating via email between her and me. At first it was nothing, just conversations about school, the subject she taught, and the things we had in common (which turned out to be a lot).

en: From the U.S.: I’ve never posted online or to a forum before, but I am desperate for advice, or even a solution. We started dating a year ago, and shortly into the relationship we became sexually involved. A few months into the relationship, I started to feel pressured into sexual encounters and so I started to alienate myself from him sexually, but that only started to make him treat me like a sex object, which began to disturb me greatly.
hr: Iz SAD-a: Nikad prije nisam ništa pisala online ili na forumu, ali očajnički mi treba savjet, ili čak rješenje. Počeli smo hodati prije godinu dana i ubrzo nakon početka veze smo se seksualno upustili. Nakon nekoliko mjeseci veze, počela sam se osjećati prisiljenom na seksualne susrete i počela sam se seksualno otuđivati od njega, ali to je samo počelo uzrokovati da me tretira kao seksualni objekt, što me počelo jako uznemiravati.

After a few months of dating, I started to feel pressured into having sexual encounters and I started to sexually alienate myself from him, but this only started to cause him to treat me like a sex object, which started to really upset me.

When we argue she says a lot of hurtful things and then randomly apologizes for it later. Its really confusing because I don’t know what she really means sometimes.
hr: Od tinejdžera iz SAD-a: Moja djevojka i ja se već neko vrijeme zabavljamo i nedavno smo prekinuli jer ona ima puno problema s kontroliranjem svojih emocija. Kad se svađamo, kaže puno bolnih stvari, a onda se kasnije nasumično ispričava zbog toga. Stvarno je zbunjujuće jer ponekad ne znam što zapravo misli.

When we fight, she says a lot of hurtful things and then later randomly apologizes for them. It's really confusing because sometimes I don't know what she's really thinking.

en: For some years I have know to be a little different from the others. I have very little emotions compared to others. I do not comprehend others, nor their problems or pain. I do not care for that. And yet I still have that 24/7 tic in my head that tells me to end them. I visualise killing them and I enjoy it. Yet I understand that taking real actions would only slow me down in achieving certain goals. I’m good at hiding as everyone perceives me to be a charming, responsible and normal guy. (this information is just context) Now, It set me to think that this may not be how everyone else thinks and feels. Psychopathy came to mind and I did some research. I came across the psychopathy checklist (PCL-R) and found that I had a 33/40 score. Of course I’m not a professional so I would like an expert’s opinion on this case.
hr: Već godinama znam biti malo drugačiji od drugih. Imam vrlo malo emocija u usporedbi s drugima. Ne razumijem druge, niti njihove probleme ili bol. To me ne zanima. Ipak, još uvijek imam taj tik u glavi koji mi govori da ih dokrajčim. Vizualiziram da ih ubijam i uživam u tome. Pa ipak, razumijem da bi me poduzimanje stvarnih akcija samo usporilo u postizanju određenih ciljeva. Dobar sam u skrivanju jer me svi doživljavaju kao šarmantnog, odgovornog i normalnog tipa. (ova informacija je samo kontekst) Sada me to navelo na razmišljanje da to možda nije način na koji svi drugi misle i osjećaju. Pala mi je na pamet psihopatija i malo sam istraživao. Naišao sam na kontrolnu listu psihopatije (PCL-R) i otkrio da imam rezultat 33/40. Naravno, nisam profesionalac pa bih volio mišljenje stručnjaka o ovom slučaju.

en: I’ve been diagnosed with PTSD. Supposedly this is from the severe bullying I went through for almost 10 years. I’ve only recently gotten help on this two months ago. While going to therapy stopped the crying and anger that I had I feel increasingly tired, I’m frustrated and downright miserable and I feel like I’m failing in life and in school. I don’t have friends. The ones I do have are from High School. I’m terrified talking to people, but yet I can do a public speech perfectly. I don’t think therapy is helping me and going from what my psychology teacher is rambling about he makes me feel like this problem is simple and I shouldn’t even be so upset.
hr: Dijagnosticiran mi je PTSP. Navodno je to posljedica teškog maltretiranja koje sam proživljavala gotovo 10 godina. Tek sam nedavno, prije dva mjeseca, dobila pomoć u vezi s tim. Iako su odlasci na terapiju prestali plakati i ljutiti se, osjećam se sve umornije, frustriranije i krajnje jadno te imam osjećaj da ne uspijevam u životu i u školi. Nemam prijatelje. Oni koje imam su iz srednje škole. Užasavam se razgovarati s ljudima, ali ipak mogu savršeno održati javni govor. Ne mislim da mi terapija pomaže, a sudeći po onome o čemu moj profesor psihologije priča, osjećam se kao da je problem jednostavan i da se ne bih trebala toliko uzrujavati.
en_back: I have been diagnosed with PTSD. It is said to be a result of severe bullying that I have been experiencing for almost 10 years. I have only recently, two months ago, gotten help for it. Although my therapy sessions have stopped the crying and getting angry, I feel increasingly tired, frustrated, and utterly miserable, and I feel like I am failing in life and school. I have no friends. The ones I do have are from high school. I am terrified of talking to people, but I can still give a perfect public speech. I don't think therapy is helping me, and from what my psychology professor is saying, I feel like the problem is simple and I shouldn't be so upset.

en: I’m obese but told that I’m not. My moods change based on how people treat or what they say to me. I get annoyed easily. I’m empathetic but act like I don’t know anything. Everything I try to succeed in I fail because I’m not good enough. I waste so much money on beauty supplies but fight the knowledge that it’s just society. I pick zits to the extent of scarring because I can’t stand anything raised on my skin. I’m an INFJ and Pisces. I watch how people judge me and it makes me regret being unique (I try to be different but within reason to what I like in general.) I often wonder why I don’t fit into this world and if there’s another but know deep inside there probably isn’t and I’m wasting time acting like this but can’t help but think of all the wonders. I always have hope for the best but never find it. All of my friends just stop talking to me and always place me on the back burner because they know I’m always there when they need me. I feel overwhelmed with life. Depression medication always makes me gain massive weight (20lbs in a month) so I don’t take them and anxiety meds won’t be prescribed because of the drug issues within our community to someone who looks like I do (tattoo’s in a rural area.) I feel like I’m supposed to do something great but I don’t know what that is and feel like I won’t know until it’s too late. I must have everything clean and in its spot at all times or I get super frustrated and lose my temper. I focus so much that I lose the concept of anything. I have around 10 major crying fits a year as said from my husband. I don’t feel attractive after having our children in 2012, 2013. I don’t feel successful, everything that is mine has gone to shit and I’ve lost a sense of self. I’m confused by the world and would like to stay tucked away in a forest with a huge fence around the area. Doctors act like they know right what it is “depression” or have no idea but would like me to ‘try’ said medication to see if it helps and it never does. What is wrong with me?!!!!
hr: Pretila sam, ali mi je rečeno da nisam. Raspoloženje mi se mijenja ovisno o tome kako se ljudi ponašaju prema meni ili što mi govore. Lako se razljutim. Empatična sam, ali se ponašam kao da ništa ne znam. Sve u čemu pokušam uspjeti, ne uspijevam jer nisam dovoljno dobra. Trošim toliko novca na kozmetičke proizvode, ali se borim protiv spoznaje da je to samo društvo. Čačkam prištiće do te mjere da mi ožilje ostanu jer ne mogu podnijeti ništa što mi se izdigne na koži. INFJ sam i Riba. Promatram kako me ljudi ocjenjuju i zbog toga žalim što sam jedinstvena (trudim se biti drugačija, ali u razumnim granicama onoga što općenito volim). Često se pitam zašto se ne uklapam u ovaj svijet i postoji li drugi, ali duboko u sebi znam da vjerojatno ne postoji i gubim vrijeme ponašajući se ovako, ali ne mogu si pomoći a da ne razmišljam o svim čudima. Uvijek se nadam najboljem, ali ga nikad ne pronađem. Svi moji prijatelji jednostavno prestanu razgovarati sa mnom i uvijek me stave u drugi plan jer znaju da sam uvijek tu kad im zatrebam. Osjećam se preopterećeno životom. Lijekovi za depresiju uvijek uzrokuju enormno debljanje (9 kg mjesečno) pa ih ne uzimam, a lijekovi za anksioznost se ne prepisuju zbog problema s drogama u našoj zajednici nekome tko izgleda kao ja (tetovaža je u ruralnom području). Osjećam se kao da bih trebala učiniti nešto veliko, ali ne znam što je to i osjećam da neću znati dok ne bude prekasno. Moram imati sve čisto i na svom mjestu u svakom trenutku ili se jako frustriram i izgubim živce. Toliko se fokusiram da izgubim pojam o bilo čemu. Imam oko 10 velikih napadaja plača godišnje, kako je rekao moj muž. Ne osjećam se privlačno nakon što smo dobili djecu 2012., 2013. Ne osjećam se uspješno, sve što je moje je otišlo u sranje i izgubila sam osjećaj za sebe. Zbunjena sam svijetom i voljela bih ostati skrivena u šumi s ogromnom ogradom oko područja. Liječnici se ponašaju kao da znaju što je to "depresija" ili nemaju pojma, ali bi htjeli da "isprobam" taj lijek kako bi vidjeli hoće li pomoći, a nikad ne pomaže. Što nije u redu sa mnom?!!!!

en: I Do Realize That I Have A Few Psychopathic Traits, However, I’m Not Sure If I Am A Psychopath Or Sociopath. Recently I’ve started to question and compare my actions and thoughts to others. I’ve started to be more aware of myself. I first noticed that whenever I would be angry at someone in close with ( a partner, parent or best friend)my usual feelings that I experience for them disappear completely and it’s as if they’ve changed from the people I care about to the people that I hate the most. So I did research starting from there. I’ve then realized that I lack empathy, guilt, remorse, compassion, you name it. However, I feel empathy for animals, not for humans. This is what’s making me confused. Once I’ve hurt someone, mostly emotionally, I wouldn’t feel guilty, even after my feelings for them have returned (after calming down). I’ve also realized that I’m very manipulative and dominant, I hate it whenever I feel like I’m not in control. I become more aggressive. And once something doesn’t go my way, I play as the victim or I try to make the person feel guilty or pity me so that they can give in. I don’t lie often, mostly because I don’t feel the need to since I don’t do bad things, I don’t mind following the rules as I think that they’re fair and don’t interfere with my life. I do lie sometimes, whenever I need to, I always get away with it. I also have superficial charm, it’s much easier to do online, I’ve noticed that people would fall for me in a matter of days to even a few hours. I don’t think that I am very narcissistic because I do have insecurities but sometimes I would feel like I am better than others, but that kind of feeling disappears quickly. I’ve been told that I can be cruel at times, I do admit that I am, especially towards people I dislike. I also feel satisfaction in seeing them hurt. I have a partner and I do get tremendously jealous, to the point that it’s emotionally violent for my partner. I would like to add that I also get bored very easily. (From Canada)
hr: Shvaćam da imam nekoliko psihopatskih osobina, međutim, nisam siguran jesam li psihopat ili sociopat. Nedavno sam počeo propitivati i uspoređivati svoje postupke i misli s drugima. Počeo sam biti svjesniji sebe. Prvo sam primijetio da kad god bih se naljutio na nekoga bliskog (partnera, roditelja ili najboljeg prijatelja), moji uobičajeni osjećaji koje osjećam prema njima potpuno nestaju i kao da su se promijenili od ljudi do kojih mi je stalo do ljudi koje najviše mrzim. Stoga sam istraživao počevši odatle. Tada sam shvatio da mi nedostaje empatije, krivnje, kajanja, suosjećanja, svega. Međutim, osjećam empatiju prema životinjama, a ne prema ljudima. To me zbunjuje. Nakon što bih nekoga povrijedio, uglavnom emocionalno, ne bih se osjećao krivim, čak ni nakon što bi se moji osjećaji prema njima vratili (nakon što bih se smirio). Također sam shvatio da sam vrlo manipulativan i dominantan, mrzim kad god osjećam da nemam kontrolu. Postajem agresivniji. I kad nešto ne ide po mom, glumim žrtvu ili pokušavam natjerati osobu da se osjeća krivom ili da me sažali kako bi mogla popustiti. Ne lažem često, uglavnom zato što ne osjećam potrebu za tim budući da ne radim loše stvari, ne smeta mi slijediti pravila jer mislim da su poštena i ne miješaju se u moj život. Ponekad lažem, kad god trebam, uvijek se izvučem. Također imam površan šarm, puno je lakše to učiniti online, primijetila sam da bi se ljudi zaljubili u mene u roku od nekoliko dana, pa čak i nekoliko sati. Ne mislim da sam jako narcisoidna jer imam nesigurnosti, ali ponekad bih se osjećala kao da sam bolja od drugih, ali taj osjećaj brzo nestaje. en_back: I realize that I have a few psychopathic traits, however, I'm not sure if I'm a psychopath or a sociopath. I've recently started questioning and comparing my actions and thoughts to others. I've started to be more self-aware. I first noticed that whenever I get angry at someone close to me (a partner, a parent, or a best friend), my usual feelings for them completely disappear and seem to change from people I care about to people I hate the most. So I started exploring from there. That's when I realized that I lack empathy, guilt, remorse, compassion, everything. However, I feel empathy for animals, not people. This confuses me. After I hurt someone, mostly emotionally, I wouldn't feel guilty, even after my feelings for them returned (after I calmed down). I also realized that I'm very manipulative and dominant, I hate whenever I feel like I'm out of control. I become more aggressive. And when something doesn't go my way, I play the victim or try to make the person feel guilty or sorry for me so they can give in. I don't lie often, mostly because I don't feel the need to since I'm not doing bad things, I don't mind following the rules because I think they're fair and they don't interfere with my life. Sometimes I lie, whenever I have to, I always get away with it. I also have a superficial charm, it's much easier to do it online, I've noticed that people would fall in love with me within a few days or even a few hours. I don't think I'm very narcissistic because I have insecurities, but sometimes I would feel like I'm better than others, but that feeling quickly goes away. I've been told that I can be cruel sometimes, I admit I am, especially to people I don't love. I also get pleasure from seeing them hurt. I have a partner and I get very jealous, to the point that it's emotionally abusive for my partner. I would like to add that I get bored very easily too. (From Canada)

en: My husband of 18 years left a year ago, with no warning. He had demonstrated some strange behaviour during this time, but he is very secretive and deceitful and can hide things very well. Within a week of leaving his family of five children he lost his job. Prior to this he had been very successful in work. The past five years however he has changed jobs many times, although I don’t think I have been told the real reason. He now doesn’t see his children at all — one of these is a tiny baby and was less than three months when he left. Before this, he was a loving father. Since leaving he has not paid any financial support for his children although he is adamant that he has. He tells so many lies it is difficult to keep track. I believe that he believes his lies as he is so convincing. He tells lies that serve no purpose and are easily proven to be lies, yet he seems convinced they are true. He is also completely paranoid and accuses people of being out to get him. He comes from a family with an alcoholic father, which has never been acknowledged. My problem is that because we have split up, I have no influence over him at all. His family won’t acknowledge that there is a problem, even though his behavior is completely out of character. I risk looking like a bitter ex wife, even though I am extremely worried about him and I know something has happened to trigger this behavior. He has gone from being a well respected father and family man to not seeing any of his children or his old friends. He has tattooed himself which he would never have done and he has run up huge debts. I am worried he will end up arrested. He has had violent out bursts, but only towards me, as far as I know. Does it sound like he has a mental health problem? I truly believe he is delusional.

She would grumble, sniff, and ask me if I thought anyone would ever like something as fat as me. Things changed when my sister was born. I do this often, but she never answers. When my sister and I talk about her, she tells me that my mother calls me a "bad kid" and a "drug loser", which I don't understand at all. Imam povijest nasilne veze s najboljom prijateljicom koju sam poznavala pola svog života, mentalno i fizički. Postala sam depresivna, nisam imala apetit, dobivala bih loše ocjene i stalno bih spavala. Sada sam bolje, ali teško mi je vjerovati drugima koji nisu moja obitelj. To je samo moja pozadina, a ovo je pravi problem. Vidjela sam da si imala slično pitanje, ali nisi dala savjet. Umjesto toga, rekla si da trebaš više informacija, pa će ovo biti dugo i detaljno.
en_back: I don't have a diagnosis, my mom says depression is a phase every teenager goes through and I'll just get over it. I have a history of being in an abusive relationship with my best friend who I've known for half my life, mentally and physically. I became depressed, had no appetite, would get bad grades, and would sleep all the time. I'm better now, but I have a hard time trusting people who aren't my family. That's just my background, and this is the real problem. I saw that you had a similar question, but you didn't give any advice. Instead, you said you needed more information, so this is going to be long and detailed.

en: I’m 14 years old, and I think I might have depression, but I’m not sure. On and off for the past year, I’ve been not motivated, and whenever I try to get organized or “Get my life together” it only lasts a few days. Yesterday I fell asleep at 8pm without doing my homework and woke up at 8am. I still felt exhausted, and my mom let me stay home because she thought I was sick, or upset about something. I told her I don’t know why I’m sad, but she thinks I just don’t want to tell her. I pretend to be happy most of the time, but I mostly just have an empty feeling.
hr: Imam 14 godina i mislim da imam depresiju, ali nisam sigurna. Povremeno tijekom protekle godine nisam bila motivirana i kad god pokušam organizirati se ili "srediti svoj život", to traje samo nekoliko dana. Jučer sam zaspala u 20 sati bez da sam napisala zadaću i probudila se u 8 sati ujutro. Još uvijek sam se osjećala iscrpljeno, a mama mi je dopustila da ostanem kod kuće jer je mislila da sam bolesna ili uzrujana zbog nečega. Rekla sam joj da ne znam zašto sam tužna, ali ona misli da joj jednostavno ne želim reći. Većinu vremena se pretvaram da sam sretna, ali uglavnom imam samo osjećaj praznine.

en: From a teen in the U.S.: This problem started when I started middle school. See, I was a shy, weak, puny, and small kid, and still am kind of. So because of that, I was bullied. Now, many people who get bullied kill themselves, but I was different. I wanted to kill the bullies instead.
hr: Od tinejdžera iz SAD-a: Ovaj problem je počeo kad sam krenuo u osnovnu školu. Vidiš, bio sam sramežljiv, slab, krhak i mali klinac, i još uvijek sam nekako. Zbog toga sam bio maltretiran. Mnogi ljudi koji su maltretirani počine samoubojstvo, ali ja sam bio drugačiji. Umjesto toga, htio sam ubiti nasilnike.
en_back: From a teenager in the US: This problem started when I started elementary school. You see, I was shy, weak, fragile, and a little kid, and I still kind of am. That's why I was bullied. A lot of people who are bullied commit suicide, but I was different. Instead, I wanted to kill the bullies.

en: Hello, so i have been diagnosed with depression and anxiety disorder, but bi polar also runs in our family and ive been feeling sypmtoms, like i will be crazy one day but in the dumps the next.also i was sexually assulted when i was 11 years old by a 13 year old boy and i havent really healed since then i used to self harm and was forced to go to therapy sessions but i stopped because i beilieve i dont need sessions any more. i constantly feel like someone is watching me, even on the toilet. i hate bugs because i believe they are really hidden cameras, the window nearest our front door is a two way mirror and people are watching me on the other side, theres a blow up toy swan in our bathroom that’s a camera too. i always feel suspicous of people because they may be fake people. My father says i am unhealthly obssesed with horror movies , serial killers, and i explore the deep web quite a bit, i have had alot of thoughts about killing people, not anyone who has angered me, that would be stupid because there would be a motive i plan and think of different ways i could kidnapp and kill diffrent people. i dont know whats going on, i will also add that at night i believe the trees hide spies, and the people in the house across the road are stalking me and are up to something sinister. i dont know if these are delusions or real life but i really want to know.
hr: Pozdrav, dijagnosticirana mi je depresija i anksiozni poremećaj, ali bipolarni poremećaj nam je također u obitelji i osjećam simptome, kao da ću jedan dan biti luda, a sljedeći dan potpuno deprimirana. Također, seksualno me zlostavljao 13-godišnji dječak kad sam imala 11 godina i od tada se nisam stvarno oporavila. Prije sam se samoozljeđivala i bila sam prisiljena ići na terapije, ali sam prestala jer vjerujem da mi više ne trebaju seanse. Stalno imam osjećaj kao da me netko promatra, čak i na WC-u. Mrzim kukce jer mislim da su to zapravo skrivene kamere. Prozor najbliži ulaznim vratima je dvosmjerno ogledalo i ljudi me promatraju s druge strane. U kupaonici imamo labuda na napuhavanje koji je također kamera. Uvijek sam sumnjičava prema ljudima jer mogu biti lažni ljudi. Moj otac kaže da sam nezdravo opsjednut horor filmovima, serijskim ubojicama i da dosta istražujem duboki web. Imao sam puno razmišljanja o ubijanju ljudi, ne nekoga tko me naljutio, to bi bilo glupo jer bi postojao motiv. Planirao sam i smišljao različite načine na koje bih mogao oteti i ubiti različite ljude. Ne znam što se događa, također ću dodati da noću vjerujem da drveće skriva špijune, a ljudi u kući preko puta me proganjaju i spremaju nešto zlokobno. Ne znam jesu li to zablude ili stvarnost, ali stvarno želim znati.
en_back: Hi, I have been diagnosed with depression and anxiety, but bipolar disorder also runs in our family and I experience symptoms like one day I'll be crazy and the next day I'll be completely depressed. I was also sexually abused by a 13-year-old boy when I was 11 and I haven't really recovered since. I used to self-harm and was forced to go to therapy, but I stopped because I don't believe I need the sessions anymore. I constantly feel like someone is watching me, even on the toilet. I hate bugs because I think they are actually hidden cameras. The window closest to the front door is a two-way mirror and people are watching me from the other side. My dad says I have an unhealthy obsession with horror movies, serial killers and that I do a lot of deep web research. I've had a lot of thoughts about killing people, not someone who made me angry, that would be stupid because there would be a motive. I planned and thought of different ways I could kidnap and kill different people. I don't know what's going on, I'll also add that at night I believe the trees are hiding spies and the people in the house across the street are chasing me and up to something sinister. I don't know if these are delusions or reality, but I really want to know.

en: From the U.S.: Five years ago my younger step-sister and I had a falling out over something that I really thought was just a misunderstanding. From the beginning I told her I wanted to repair the relationship only to be completely shut out by her… no communication via social media, email or text. Throughout the years I have continued to send tentative contact her way and have been ignored, even after the birth of her son which I thought would soften our relationship. Because she is my step-sister and I am not around her mother and my dad very often we almost never accidentally cross-paths. The few times we have she has been friendly to me, as if nothing is wrong. She encourages I interact with her son and calls me Auntie to him. I always see this as signs of hope for us, but when I reach out to her I get nothing back.
hr: Iz SAD-a: Prije pet godina moja mlađa polusestra i ja smo se posvađale oko nečega za što sam stvarno mislila da je samo nesporazum. Od početka sam joj govorila da želim popraviti vezu, samo da bi me potpuno isključila... nikakva komunikacija putem društvenih mreža, e-pošte ili poruka. Tijekom godina nastavila sam joj slati probne kontakte i bila sam ignorirana, čak i nakon rođenja sina, za što sam mislila da će omekšati naš odnos. Budući da mi je polusestra i nisam često u blizini njezine majke i oca, gotovo se nikada slučajno ne sretnemo. Nekoliko puta kada jesmo, bila je prijateljski nastrojena prema meni, kao da ništa nije u redu. Potiče me da komuniciram s njezinim sinom i zove me teta. Uvijek to vidim kao znakove nade za nas, ali kada joj se obratim, ne dobijem ništa zauzvrat.
en_back: From the US: Five years ago, my younger half-sister and I had a fight over what I really thought was just a misunderstanding. I told her from the start that I wanted to fix our relationship, only to have her completely shut me out... no social media, email, or texting. Over the years, I continued to send tentative contacts to her and was ignored, even after the birth of our son, which I thought would soften our relationship. Since she is my half-sister and I am not around her mother and father very often, we almost never meet up by chance. The few times we have, she has been friendly to me, as if nothing is wrong. She encourages me to communicate with her son and calls me aunt. I always see these as signs of hope for us, but when I reach out to her, I get nothing in return.

en: For as long as I can remember I have been backwards when it come to sleep. Since I was 8 yrs old I stay up until 3A-6A and then sleep during the day. When I was younger I was forced to go to school but during high school I was allowed to do whatever, so I worked in the evening and then stayed up at night.
hr: Otkad znam za sebe, spavanje je uvijek bilo nazadno. Otkad mi je bilo 8 godina, ostajem budan do 3:00-6:00 ujutro, a onda spavam tijekom dana. Kad sam bio mlađi, bio sam prisiljen ići u školu, ali tijekom srednje škole smio sam raditi što god, pa sam radio navečer, a onda ostajao budan noću.
en_back: For as long as I can remember, I've always been a sleep-deprived person. Since I was 8, I've been staying up until 3:00-6:00 in the morning, then sleeping during the day. When I was younger, I was forced to go to school, but during high school I was allowed to do whatever I wanted, so I worked in the evenings, then stayed up at night.

en: From a teen in the U.S.: This issue started shortly after I graduated high school and it’;s been going on for 2 months. When it first started I was questioning time and how it works. I had a few panic attacks in relation to that. Then after that I started questioning what I’m seeing and if it’s actually real. That led to me questioning my existence and I feel totally disconnected from the person I used to be.
hr: Od tinejdžera iz SAD-a: Ovaj problem je počeo ubrzo nakon što sam završio srednju školu i traje već 2 mjeseca. Kad je prvi put počelo, preispitivao sam vrijeme i kako ono funkcionira. Imao sam nekoliko napadaja panike u vezi s tim. Nakon toga počeo sam preispitivati što vidim i je li to zapravo stvarno. To me dovelo do preispitivanja vlastitog postojanja i osjećam se potpuno odvojeno od osobe kakva sam nekad bio.

en: It has been more than a year now , I feel alone, depressed, don’t feel like talking to anyone, just like to be alone. Also have been too much emotional these days. I don’t have any girl friend or even a person who cares for me , except my mother, in my entire life. This all has started because I cant see my mother not getting respect from my father after staying with him for almost 30 years. I feel this so much , but I am not able to speak on this with either of them. I just keep on crying from inside. I cry while sleeping thinking of all this. This is affecting my behavior and I am no more a social person. I have lost all my friends. Even in office I just talk work. Some of my close friends say that I inspire them with the way I work, but when I come back home I just see all those things which I have seen over the years which makes me to forget the kind of person I am or I was to be. I am confident when it is work, but when colleagues go for tea break or lunch together I am uncomfortable to go with them as I don’t know or I am not confident on my behavior. I am fed up of all these, these days and I am seeking for an advice or help. It would be glad if someone can talk to me or can help me to find way out of this. Thanks in advance !! (age 26,from India)
hr: Prošlo je više od godinu dana, osjećam se usamljeno, depresivno, ne da mi se ni s kim razgovarati, samo volim biti sam. Također sam previše emotivan ovih dana. Nemam nijednu djevojku ili čak osobu koja brine za mene, osim moje majke, u cijelom svom životu. Sve je ovo počelo jer ne mogu zamisliti da moja majka ne dobiva poštovanje od mog oca nakon što sam s njim živjela gotovo 30 godina. Toliko to osjećam, ali ne mogu o tome razgovarati ni s jednom od njih. Samo stalno plačem iznutra. Plačem dok spavam razmišljajući o svemu ovome. To utječe na moje ponašanje i više nisam društvena osoba. Izgubila sam sve svoje prijatelje. Čak i u uredu pričam samo o poslu. Neki od mojih bliskih prijatelja kažu da ih inspiriram načinom na koji radim, ali kad se vratim kući, samo vidim sve te stvari koje sam vidio tijekom godina, zbog čega zaboravljam kakva sam osoba ili kakva bih trebala biti. Nikad nisam dobio ljubav. Zbog svega toga moje samopoštovanje je jako nisko. Samouvjeren sam kad je u pitanju posao, ali kad kolege odu zajedno na pauzu za čaj ili ručak, neugodno mi je ići s njima jer ne znam ili nisam siguran u svoje ponašanje. Ne spavam dobro, ostajem budan kasno noću, ustajem kasno ujutro. Smršavio sam i ne jedem puno. Što se tiče moje prošlosti, nisam uspio uspostaviti puno prijateljstava u školi i na fakultetu. Čak su me i u obitelji uvijek držali po strani za sve važne stvari, misle da to ne mogu učiniti samo zato što ne pričam puno. Dosta mi je svega ovoga i tražim savjet ili pomoć. Bio bih zahvalan ako netko može razgovarati sa mnom ili mi pomoći da pronađem izlaz iz ovoga. Hvala unaprijed!! (26 godina, iz Indije)
en_back: It's been over a year, I feel lonely, depressed, I don't feel like talking to anyone, I just like being alone. I'm also too emotional these days. en: From a young woman in Canada: We dated for 2 years, lived together and were really in love. I had problems moving to a new city a lot of things happened and I was unhappy with anxiety. It was too much on him and we broke up. We tried again but he would be hot and cold.. one moment he would say he was committed to trying and the next I wasn’t right for him. He said he still loves me and he can’t.
hr: Od mlade žene iz Kanade: Hodali smo 2 godine, živjeli zajedno i bili smo jako zaljubljeni. Imala sam problema s preseljenjem u novi grad, puno se toga dogodilo i bila sam nesretna zbog tjeskobe. Bilo je previše za njega i prekinuli smo. Pokušali smo ponovno, ali on bi bio i vruć i hladan... u jednom trenutku bi rekao da je odlučan pokušati, a u sljedećem ja nisam prava za njega. Rekao je da me još uvijek voli i da ne može.

I was having trouble moving to a new city, a lot had happened, and I was miserable because of anxiety. It was too much for him and we broke up. We tried again, but he would be hot and cold... one moment he would say he was determined to try, and the next I wasn't right for him. He said he still loved me and that he couldn't.

en: Ever since i can remember I have always been an angry person. hr: Otkad znam za sebe, oduvijek sam bila ljutita osoba. Kad biste me upoznali, pomislili biste da nemam nikakvih briga na svijetu. Radim u maloprodaji i zvali su me "zabavna, vesela, uvijek sretna*, preslatka" itd. Osjećam se kao da na poslu imam tu prevaru gdje jednostavno ne želim da vide moju ljutitu stranu, pa im je ne pokazujem. Jedini ljudi prema kojima zapravo oslobađam sav svoj bijes su moja mama, sestra i moj dečko.
en_back: For as long as I can remember, I've always been an angry person. I get really angry at my mom for stupid things (to the point of yelling at her for no reason, and I know it's wrong to do it, but I do it anyway) and I overanalyze EVERYTHING. If you met me, you'd think I didn't have a care in the world. en: I don’t know the best way to explain myself so please bear with me. I tend to have a lot of issues going on in my head. First of all I don’t feel like I think, or have the capacity to think like a normal person. I tend to get different ideas or incorrect information from what people are explaining to me, or it just takes me a long time to process the information that is given to me. This causes me to come off as stupid, or makes me seem that I don’t care. Another thing is I take my transgressions toward others very seriously, when I feel like I’ve don’t something wrong, or let someone down I really take it to heart because I don’t want to be the cause of someone’s disappointment. I feel this is the right thing to do, but I always feel like I’ve don’t something wrong when I express this to my friends or co-workers. Growing up I always felt like I was an intelligent person. I never really thought like a child and was always more aware of myself and how my actions affected those around me than most other children. I love learning, but can’t seem to understand what people are saying to me. I’ve always had this inner monologue that is either pushing me to do something I don’t want to do, or just telling me negative things about myself. I’ve actually caught myself sometimes arguing out loud with this voice. It was me speaking the whole time, but in two different tones. Also I tend to see really horrible images in my head. For example if I see a plane flying by I’ll see it blowing up right in front of my eyes. Or if I’m see a person walking down the street I’ll see them getting hit by a car. I don’t want these things to happen and it really upsets me when I see them to the point where I’ll sometimes start crying. Right now I just had something happen at work that I feel terrible about and it affected everyone in the building. All I keep seeing is me running and jumping out the open window in the office before anyone could stop me. I wouldn’t do it, but I keep feeling this way. These things cause many problems all of my relationships. Any Advice?
hr: Ne znam kako bih se najbolje objasnio, stoga vas molim za strpljenje. Sklon sam imati puno problema u glavi. Prije svega, ne osjećam se kao da razmišljam ili da nemam sposobnost razmišljati kao normalna osoba. Nikada nisam stvarno razmišljao kao dijete i uvijek sam bio svjesniji sebe i kako moji postupci utječu na one oko mene nego većina druge djece. Volim učiti, ali čini se da ne razumijem što mi ljudi govore. Uvijek sam imala taj unutarnji monolog koji me ili tjera da radim nešto što ne želim ili mi jednostavno govori negativne stvari o sebi. Ponekad sam se uhvatila kako se naglas svađam s tim glasom. Ja sam govorila cijelo vrijeme, ali u dva različita tona. Također, sklona sam vidjeti stvarno strašne slike u glavi. I don't want those things to happen and it really upsets me when I see them to the point that I sometimes start crying. Something just happened at work that makes me feel terrible and it's affected everyone in the building. All I keep seeing is me running and jumping out an open window in my office before anyone can stop me. I wouldn't do it, but I feel that way all the time. These things cause a lot of problems in all my relationships. Do you have any advice?

en: Back in December I hit a really bad depressive episode. My relationship with my girlfriend of 3 years wasn’t going well and work was highly stressful. I went into work that morning and got into a verbal altercation with a co-worker who never liked me. That was it, I was fed up with the world. I couldn’t take it anymore. So I went home and around 9pm locked myself in my room and attempted to overdose on my medication for diabetes and depression.
hr: U prosincu sam imao jako tešku depresivnu epizodu. Moj odnos s djevojkom s kojom sam bio 3 godine nije išao dobro, a posao je bio jako stresan. Tog jutra sam otišao na posao i posvađao se s kolegom koji me nikad nije volio. To je bilo to, bio sam sit svijeta. Nisam to više mogao podnijeti. Zato sam otišao kući i oko 21 sat se zaključao u sobu te pokušao predozirati lijekovima za dijabetes i depresiju.

en: I believe, and my family members also believe, that I was suffering from serious paranoid delusions for years. I also had repetitive physical movements that I couldn’t control, and some hallucinations. I came out of it spontaneously, without medication two and a half years ago.
hr: Vjerujem, a i članovi moje obitelji vjeruju, da sam godinama patio od ozbiljnih paranoidnih deluzija. Također sam imao ponavljajuće fizičke pokrete koje nisam mogao kontrolirati i neke halucinacije. Iz toga sam se spontano, bez lijekova, izvukao prije dvije i pol godine.

en: From a woman in the U.S.: I have never been able to get an answer to this. We got a family puppy when I was in the 9th grade. Our puppy was scared of being in boxes in which he couldn’t climb out. He would panic and cry for someone to get him out. My mother enjoyed putting the puppy in a box to see what he did and let him panic and cry until I couldn’t take it anymore and picked him up.
hr: Od žene iz SAD-a: Nikad nisam uspjela dobiti odgovor na ovo. Nabavili smo obiteljsko štene kad sam bila u 9. razredu. Naše štene se bojalo biti u kutijama iz kojih nije moglo izaći. Paničarilo bi i plakalo tražeći da ga netko izvuče. Moja majka je uživala stavljati štene u kutiju da vidi što radi i puštala ga da paničari i plače dok više nisam mogla izdržati i uzela ga u naručje.

en: My Dad and I usually get on quite well. We have a lot in common, but whenever he cooks or cleans he doesn’t do the job properly. For instance, he won’t wash his hands before cooking or clean the sides down properly. I’m generally not that bothered by germs but everyone knows the basics of hygiene in the kitchen. I try to tell him that he should wash his hands, but he just get annoyed, and makes some excuse like he’s ‘thinking about other things’. 9 times out of 10 he doesn’t do the washing up properly either eg. there will still be oil on the frying pan. So when I try to do it or I tell him that it’s unclean he just gets irritated and says “your being rather annoying now” when I’m just trying to makes sure my sister and I get a healthy meal in a clean kitchen. My mum usually makes sure that the kitchen and everything else is clean but she’s away seeing her parents because my grandma’s going into surgery soon. Now my dad’s left with us he just seems incapable of doing even basic chores. I can’t keep pestering him but he doesn’t learn. It could be that he listens to my mum or that she does it usually and dad hasn’t had to do the washing up more than once every few days. I think it’s a bit of both.
hr: Tata i ja se obično dobro slažemo. Imamo puno toga zajedničkog, ali kad god kuha ili čisti, ne obavi posao kako treba. Na primjer, ne opere ruke prije kuhanja niti dobro očisti stranice. Općenito me ne smetaju klice, ali svi znaju osnove higijene u kuhinji. Pokušavam mu reći da bi trebao oprati ruke, ali on se samo iznervira i izmisli neki izgovor kao da 'razmišlja o drugim stvarima'. 9 od 10 puta ne opere ni suđe kako treba, npr. još uvijek će biti ulja na tavi. Dakle, kad pokušam to učiniti ili mu kažem da je nečisto, on se samo iznervira i kaže "sada si prilično dosadan", a ja se samo trudim osigurati da sestra i ja dobijemo zdrav obrok u čistoj kuhinji. Moja mama obično pazi da kuhinja i sve ostalo bude čisto, ali je odsutna kod roditelja jer baka uskoro ide na operaciju. Sada kada je tata ostao s nama, čini se da nije sposoban obavljati ni osnovne kućanske poslove. Ne mogu ga stalno gnjaviti, ali ne uči. Moguće je da sluša moju mamu ili da ona to obično radi, a tata nije morao prati suđe više od jednom svakih nekoliko dana. Mislim da je pomalo od oboje.

It's possible that he listens to my mom or that she usually does it, and dad didn't have to do the dishes more than once every few days. I think it's a bit of both.

en: I’m 15 years old and I’m an only child. When I was 10 I found out that when I was two my mom had suffered from depression, my dad said it was because she was pregnant and then had a still born baby on Christmas Eve. However very soon after my parents talked to me about that my mom lost her job and was out of work for two years. She started changing, she was gaining a lot of weight and would cry all the time. All my life she had been able to sleep a lot but once she lost her job she wouldn’t get out of bed for days. Once she got a new job she seemed “happier” but then she became obsessed with work and likewise obsessed with my schoolwork. It was unacceptable if I got a B, it wasn’t “good enough.” However even though she had a job she would sleep all the time and would always be crying. It got to the point that between work and sleeping she didn’t have time for any of the normal mom things. She stopped doing laundry, cleaning, coming to my basketball games, and so I picked up her slack. Ever since I’ve been doing all my families laundry, cleaning the house, planning out what we need from the grocery store every week and if she ever offered to for example do the dishes so I could go to bed I’d wake up the next morning and they wouldn’t be done. Whenever I would talk to my dad about her he would say that that’s just how she is now because of her brain and that whenever she freaked out on me to not take it personally. Recently me and my mom were driving to Pennsylvania to visit family and she had a panic attack while driving she swore that the truck drivers were out to get her so she pulled over for an hour trying to “clear her head”. Also every time I try to talk to her about a problem with a guy or anything she turns it into her problem and I always end up holding her while she can’t stop crying. All of this started, because she lost the baby and after she lost the baby it was like I wasn’t good enough for her. I wasn’t a good enough reason for her to try to get better I wasn’t good enough to keep her happy I wasn’t good enough for her because I got a 92 in biology and “ruined my chances of going to a good college.” If I’ve never been good enough for her then how can I be good enough to help her? (age 15, from US)
hr: Imam 15 godina i jedinica sam. Kad sam imala 10 godina, saznala sam da je moja mama, s dvije godine, patila od depresije. Tata je rekao da je to zato što je bila trudna i rodila mrtvorođenče na Badnjak. Međutim, vrlo brzo nakon što su mi roditelji o tome razgovarali, mama je izgubila posao i bila je bez posla dvije godine. Počela se mijenjati, puno se debljala i stalno je plakala. Cijeli moj život je puno spavala, ali kad je izgubila posao, danima nije ustajala iz kreveta. Kad je dobila novi posao, činila se "sretnijom", ali onda je postala opsjednuta poslom, a isto tako i mojim školskim zadaćama. Bilo je neprihvatljivo da dobijem četvorku, nije bilo "dovoljno dobro". Međutim, iako je imala posao, stalno je spavala i uvijek je plakala. Došlo je do toga da između posla i spavanja nije imala vremena ni za jednu od uobičajenih majčinskih stvari. Prestala je prati rublje, čistiti, dolaziti na moje košarkaške utakmice, pa sam je ja preuzela na sebe. Otkad perem rublje za cijelu obitelj, čistim kuću, planiram što nam treba iz trgovine svaki tjedan, i ako bi se ikada ponudila, na primjer, oprati suđe kako bih mogla ići spavati, probudila bih se sljedeće jutro i ništa ne bi bilo gotovo. Kad god bih razgovarala s tatom o njoj, rekao bi da je jednostavno takva kakva je sada zbog svog mozga i da kad god bi se iznervirala na mene, da to ne shvaćam osobno. Nedavno smo mama i ja vozile u Pennsylvaniju posjetiti obitelj i ona je imala napad panike dok je vozila, klela se da su je vozači kamiona došli uhvatiti pa je stala na sat vremena pokušavajući "razbistriti glavu". Također, svaki put kad pokušam razgovarati s njom o problemu s nekim dečkom ili nečim sličnim, ona to pretvori u svoj problem i uvijek završim držeći je dok ne može prestati plakati. Sve je to počelo jer je izgubila bebu, a nakon što je izgubila bebu, bilo je kao da nisam dovoljno dobra za nju. Nisam bio dovoljno dobar razlog da se pokuša poboljšati. Nisam bio dovoljno dobar da je usrećim. Nisam bio dovoljno dobar za nju jer sam dobio 92 iz biologije i „uništio si šanse da upišem dobar fakultet“. Ako nikad nisam bio dovoljno dobar za nju, kako onda mogu biti dovoljno dobar da joj pomognem? (15 godina, iz SAD-a)

en: Hi, I was wondering if you could tell me if I need to turn in me or my ex to authorities. First, my ex was not very kind to me when I was with him. I told him I had a severe form of Non-Verbal Learning Disability when I got diagnosed and that the reason I am somewhat okay socially is because my parents always over encouraged me to be social and one of my friends taught me how to talk to people “normally”(and I’d go to my parents with any social questions). He would tell me I seemed fine and I would tell him that part of it was my generalized anxiety making me stay more quiet and overthink and overthink until I figured out non-awkward or offensive things to say (esp. in a text). When I would bring this up, he would basically tell me to try harder because when we first dated (and I was on Abilify, an antipsychotic that actually can help autistics), I didn’t act so different. Also during the relationship, he told me that he laughed during gore scenes in movies and had obsessive urges to harm people, but drowned it out with stories he told himself and video games. Now that we are broken up and he treats the relationship as if it were my fault for it ending and makes me do all the work to get him to talk to me, we have parted ways completely, and too often I have urges to harm him, mainly to show him the pain he caused me and my cause other, and also because he is entering the military with confidential computer data access which scares me. I’m angry with myself for becoming like him, but he called me out of my mind once, and I had a psychiatrist that tried to convince me I was with practically no evidence. Granted I was histrionic in the relationship and easily anxious that he’d break up with me when we had a really intense text fight involving all caps. He also accused me more than once of cheating when I never once cheated. Never agreed to call me as my therapist suggested us do for my NVLD. Told me it was my fault I struggled so badly to pay attention to my teacher because she never stayed on one topic. He wasn’t nice.
hr: Bok, zanima me možete li mi reći trebam li sebe ili svog bivšeg prijaviti vlastima. Prvo, moj bivši nije bio baš ljubazan prema meni dok sam bila s njim. en: My mind tends to wander and daydream on random topics throughout the day. (undiagnosed ADHD as a child and adult) For years these thoughts, who are always pleasant at first, always take a turn for the worst and a replaced by a common themed negative thought. Example: I see someone play soccer. I remember back to when I played soccer in school and I’m happy. Then my mind flashes back to a memory of soccer that I cringe and am ashamed at.
hr: Moj um ima tendenciju lutanja i sanjarenja o nasumičnim temama tijekom dana. (nedijagnosticiran ADHD kao dijete i odrasla osoba) Godinama te misli, koje su u početku uvijek ugodne, uvijek se preokrenu u gore i zamijene ih uobičajena negativna misao. Primjer: Vidim nekoga kako igra nogomet. Sjećam se kad sam ja igrao nogomet u školi i sretan sam. Tada mi se u mislima vrati sjećanje na nogomet zbog kojeg se stresem i sramim se.

en: I am trying to figure out if certain problem I am currently experiencing is social phobia, paranoia, or it is something serious like schizophrenia. It started when I (age 26) went on a trip to Europe with my brother and I got a terrible flu, and on our tour bus I began having a psychosis. I thought I could hear the whole bus talking about me being stupid and ugly. Even outside where we couldn’t find people from our tour bus, I heard them talking about me, it freaked me out so much I had to ask my brother if he could hear it too , which he said no. I did have a high fever so that could have explained what was happening, but even after that occurrence there are times, not every day, I go out and I feel like I can hear people calling me ugly and stupid, or if they are laughing I think they are laughing at me. I moved to the city and I rarely want to go out because I’m afraid I will have an episode again. My boyfriend knows when I have these episodes because I become quiet and disoriented. That is because I try to listen to peoples conversations and find out if I’m going crazy or they are talking about me. Also, I do not hear voices when I am alone but only when there are people around talking so I do not know if it is because I keep mishearing or interpreting the wrong way. I am worried and not sure if I need to seek help from a therapist. Thank you for your help. I would like to add that I do not take any medications or drugs.
hr: Pokušavam shvatiti je li određeni problem koji trenutno imam socijalna fobija, paranoja ili je nešto ozbiljno poput shizofrenije. Imala sam visoku temperaturu pa je to moglo objasniti što se događa, ali čak i nakon tog događaja postoje trenuci, ne svaki dan, kada izađem i osjećam se kao da čujem ljude kako me nazivaju ružnom i glupom, ili ako se smiju, mislim da se smiju meni. To je zato što pokušavam slušati razgovore ljudi i otkriti ludim li ili pričaju o meni. Također, ne čujem glasove kad sam sama, već samo kad netko razgovara u blizini, pa ne znam je li to zato što stalno krivo čujem ili krivo tumačim. en: About 5 years ago, I made a deal with my dad that I would try out 10 episodes of his favorite TV show because he really wanted me to try it. Then he said if I didn’t like it, I wouldn’t have to watch it anymore. I didn’t like it — sci-fi isn’t my genre. Anyway, my dad has asked a few times every year since then if I’ll try the show again, and I always say no and remind him I don’t like it. He says I didn’t give it a fair shot, and basically says anyone would like it. It involves some gory things like worms coming out of someone’s stomach, and I hate watching any violence or gory things. He tries to argue with me about why I’ll like it, but I’ve always hated sci-fi. I’ve offered to watch a show that we both like together. My dad has said multiple times “there’s no way you’re my daughter” or “you can’t be my daughter” since I hate sci-fi. I’m adamant against watching this show because I think he’s not respecting my answer and always wanted his kids to be interested in what he is interested in. He has tried to manipulate me by saying he would do what his father asked, and that if I’m so inflexible on this I’m bound to have problems in future relationships. He has said he doesn’t ask much of me. My dad has guilt-tripped me my whole life and has always been controlling. Maybe my resistance is partially coming from a huge history. Recently he asked again and I said no– I have a big problem being assertive, and I’m practicing sticking up for myself. I very rarely stick up for myself with my dad because he’s so overbearing.

I can't hold down a job because I have extremely severe anxiety. I kind of feel like I'm going crazy for feeling or thinking the way I feel. I just want to know if I should seek help, maybe this is normal and everyone else feels this way?

en: from the U.S.: My earliest, clear childhood memories began at about age 10-11. From what I’ve read, blocked memories are most often associated with some kind of traumatic event, but what I can recollect of my childhood was, while certainly not perfect, generally happy. (Although I suppose the whole point of this is that if there was trauma and I’ve blocked out the memory, of course I wouldn’t remember it…? It’s all a little frustrating.)
hr: iz SAD-a: Moja najranija, jasna sjećanja iz djetinjstva započela su otprilike u dobi od 10-11 godina. Iz onoga što sam pročitao, blokirana sjećanja najčešće su povezana s nekom vrstom traumatskog događaja, ali ono čega se sjećam iz svog djetinjstva bilo je, iako sigurno ne savršeno, uglavnom sretno. (Iako pretpostavljam da je cijela poanta ovoga da ako je postojala trauma i ako sam blokirao sjećanje, naravno da se ne bih sjećao...? Sve je to pomalo frustrirajuće.)
en_back: from the USA: My earliest, clear childhood memories started around the age of 10-11. en: I have had this problem for the majority of life where it began with a suicidal depression at the age of 9. I no longer have strong impulses to commit suicide, although these visual thoughts and impulses has changed into hurting or even killing others. I am a visual thinker, which I guess is why these thoughts seems so lifelike. These thoughts also come very sudden, and are related to the present situation I am in. I am right now in a relationship with my girlfriend and we have a child (2 years old) and two cats. I have had previous thoughts of harming my girlfriend, which is usual to me since I get these thoughts often towards other humans. On the other hand it started bothering me when I got very strong, visual impulses to hurt our infant child. I got real reason to worry since I have never been good to remember any dreams, but the last two or three I can remember involves harming or killing our daughter, which is very distressfull. Sometimes these impulses can be very hard to handle, which is the reason why I chose to register on this website. We got a new kitten the other day, and even that she is in a new location, she has adapted very well. But due to something as simple as her not wanting a cuddle drove both thoughts and action to treat her very aggressively and rough. Stopping myself from harming it, I had to sit alone in 15 minutes to calm myself down. I am concerned that if I can’t control my impulses to something as innocent as a kitten, what can happen in the future towards my daughter? Thanks for helping.
hr: Veći dio života imam ovaj problem, a sve je počelo suicidalnom depresijom u dobi od 9 godina. Više nemam snažne impulse za samoubojstvom, iako su se te vizualne misli i impulsi pretvorili u nanošenje ozljeda ili čak ubijanje drugih. Vizualno razmišljam, što je, pretpostavljam, razlog zašto mi se ove misli čine tako realističnima. Ove misli također dolaze vrlo iznenada i povezane su sa trenutnom situacijom u kojoj se nalazim. Trenutno sam u vezi sa svojom djevojkom i imamo dijete (2 godine) i dvije mačke. Imao sam ranije misli o nanošenju ozljeda svojoj djevojci, što mi je uobičajeno jer često imam te misli prema drugim ljudima. S druge strane, počelo me mučiti kada sam dobio vrlo snažne, vizualne impulse da nanesem ozljedu našem dojenčetu. Imam pravi razlog za brigu jer se nikada nisam dobro sjećao snova, ali posljednja dva ili tri kojih se sjećam uključuju nanošenje ozljeda ili ubijanje naše kćeri, što je vrlo uznemirujuće. Ponekad je vrlo teško podnijeti te impulse, što je razlog zašto sam se odlučio registrirati na ovoj web stranici. Nedavno smo dobili mačića i čak i ako je na novoj lokaciji, jako se dobro prilagodio. Ali nešto tako jednostavno kao što je to što nije htjela maženje navelo je i misli i djela da se prema njoj ponašaju vrlo agresivno i grubo. Kako bih se spriječila da mu naudi, morala sam sjediti sama 15 minuta kako bih se smirila. Zabrinuta sam da ako ne mogu kontrolirati svoje impulse prema nečemu tako nevinom poput mačića, što se u budućnosti može dogoditi mojoj kćeri? Hvala na pomoći.

But something as simple as her not wanting to be petted has caused both thoughts and actions to be very aggressive and harsh towards her. To stop myself from hurting her, I had to sit alone for 15 minutes to calm down. I am worried that if I can't control my impulses towards something as innocent as a kitten, what could happen to my daughter in the future? Thanks for your help.

en: Hi. I’ve been suicidal for the past couple of months, but it’s recently become a more realistic issue. Before, I had suicidal thoughts and ideations, but only thought seriously about them on occasion, whereas now, it seems to be the only way to end everything. I find i spend the majority of the day thinking up ways to kill myself, and am waiting for the right moment (ie. when family would be less hurt.). I have many different plans — they’re sort of separated into 2 columns. One column: what i deserve. Second column: What’s more likely to be successful. Thing is, my mood goes up and down — sort of like Bipolar, but the majority of the time, I’m depressed. when i’m in an “up” mood, (which is more like unbelievable anger rather than elation, with the occasional happy high,) I hate myself for even thinking it, and punish myself for being so selfish — not thinking about what it’d do to my family, but when I’m in a depressed mood, It seems to be the only way out, and the thought is a sort of stimulant. I think to myself “It’s okay, Not long left in this life.”
hr: Bok. Posljednjih nekoliko mjeseci imam suicidalne misli, ali to je nedavno postalo realnije pitanje. Prije sam imala suicidalne misli i ideje, ali sam o njima ozbiljno razmišljala samo povremeno, dok se sada čini da je to jedini način da se svemu stane na kraj. Većinu dana provodim smišljajući načine kako se ubiti i čekam pravi trenutak (tj. kada će obitelj biti manje povrijeđena). Imam mnogo različitih planova - nekako su podijeljeni u 2 stupca. Jedan stupac: što zaslužujem. Drugi stupac: Što ima veće šanse za uspjeh. Stvar je u tome što mi raspoloženje ide gore-dolje - pomalo kao bipolarni poremećaj, ali većinu vremena sam depresivna. Kad sam u "dobrom" raspoloženju (što je više poput nevjerojatnog bijesa nego ushićenja, s povremenim "sretnim ushićenjem"), mrzim sebe što uopće pomislim na to i kažnjavam se što sam toliko sebična - ne razmišljam o tome što bi to učinilo mojoj obitelji, ali kad sam u depresivnom raspoloženju, čini se da je to jedini izlaz i ta misao je neka vrsta stimulansa. Mislim si: "U redu je, nije mi ostalo dugo u ovom životu."
en_back: Hi. I've been having suicidal thoughts for the past few months, but it's become a more real issue recently. I used to have suicidal thoughts and ideas, but I only seriously considered them occasionally, whereas now it seems like the only way to end it all. I spend most of my days thinking about ways to kill myself and waiting for the right moment (i.e. when my family will be less hurt). I have many different plans - they're sort of divided into 2 columns. One column: what I deserve. The other column: What has a better chance of success. The thing is, my moods go up and down - a bit like bipolar disorder, but most of the time I'm depressed. When I'm in a "good" mood (which is more like incredible rage than elation, with the occasional "happy elation"), I hate myself for even thinking about it and punish myself for being so selfish - I don't think about what it would do to my family, but when I'm in a depressed mood, it seems like the only way out and the thought is a kind of stimulant. I think to myself, "It's okay, I don't have long left in this life."

en: From a teen in Australia: Lately I’ve been feeling no point to life and I can never think straight. My home life is horrible as i have an abusive older sister who i used to be very close with and now my parents always yell at me and call me the abusive one. I have often panic attacks, i vomited recently after a traumatic event and i can never walk away from my technology no matter how hard i try. My school life is also horrible as i feel that not even my closest friends trust and rely on me and i think i cant rely on them most of the time anyways.
hr: Od tinejdžerice iz Australije: U posljednje vrijeme osjećam besmislenost života i nikad ne mogu jasno razmišljati. Moj obiteljski život je užasan jer imam stariju sestru koja me zlostavlja i s kojom sam prije bila jako bliska, a sada mi roditelji stalno viču i nazivaju me zlostavljačicom. Često imam napade panike, nedavno sam povraćala nakon traumatičnog događaja i nikad se ne mogu odvojiti od tehnologije koliko god se trudila. Moj školski život je također užasan jer osjećam da mi čak ni moji najbliži prijatelji ne vjeruju i ne oslanjaju se na mene, a mislim da se ionako većinu vremena ne mogu osloniti na njih.

en: Hi. I have a problem forming relationships with people. I’ve been working at this place for like 8 months and i still find it really difficult forming interpersonal relationships with everyone here. Not only people in the work place but also family members. I’ve noticed that every time I’m joking around and laughing with someone and getting along with them extremely well, i tend to back off and completely shut down after I’ve noticed that I’m happy or talking a lot. It’s really weird. I do have self-esteem issues and self-confidence issues and i believe i suffer from social anxiety and depression. I so badly want to form relationships with people but it’s like I’m not even allowing myself to you know? My childhood COULD have been better. My dad was a hermit and he didn’t talk to people that well and my mom was an alcoholic at the time so i don’t know if that has something to do with anything. I do remember that i was distant from people even when i was a kid as well. Well not so much distant but it seemed like i needed permission from my friends to go with them places, like i needed to know that i was needed and they liked being around me. I just want to know like what the hell is wrong with me? I just want to be happy. I want to feel normal and BE normal. HELP!
hr: Bok. Imam problem s uspostavljanjem odnosa s ljudima. Radim ovdje već oko 8 mjeseci i još uvijek mi je jako teško uspostaviti međuljudske odnose sa svima ovdje. Ne samo s ljudima na poslu, već i s članovima obitelji. Primijetila sam da se svaki put kad se šalim i smijem s nekim i slažem se s njim izvrsno, sklona sam povući i potpuno zatvoriti nakon što primijetim da sam sretna ili puno pričam. Stvarno je čudno. Imam problema sa samopoštovanjem i samopouzdanjem i mislim da patim od socijalne anksioznosti i depresije. Toliko želim uspostaviti odnose s ljudima, ali kao da si to ni ne dopuštam, znate? Moje djetinjstvo je MOGLO biti bolje. Moj tata je bio pustinjak i nije dobro razgovarao s ljudima, a moja mama je u to vrijeme bila alkoholičarka, tako da ne znam ima li to ikakve veze s tim. Sjećam se da sam bila distancirana od ljudi čak i kao dijete. Pa, ne toliko udaljena, ali činilo se kao da mi je trebalo dopuštenje prijatelja da idem s njima na neka mjesta, kao da sam trebala znati da sam potrebna i da im se sviđa biti u mojoj blizini. Samo sam htjela znati što je, dovraga, sa mnom? Samo želim biti sretna. Želim se osjećati normalno i BITI normalna. POMOĆ!
en_back: Hi. I have a problem with connecting with people. I've been working here for about 8 months now and I still have a really hard time connecting with everyone here. Not just with people at work, but also with my family. I've noticed that every time I'm joking and laughing with someone and I get along great with them, I tend to withdraw and completely shut down after I notice that I'm happy or talking a lot. It's really weird. I have problems with self-esteem and confidence and I think I suffer from social anxiety and depression. I want to connect with people so much, but I don't even let myself, you know? My childhood COULD have been better. My dad was a recluse and didn't talk to people very well, and my mom was an alcoholic at the time, so I don't know if that has anything to do with it. I remember being distant from people even as a child. Well, not that far away, but it felt like I needed my friends' permission to go places with them, like I needed to know I was needed and that they liked being around me. I just wanted to know what the hell was wrong with me? I just want to be happy. I want to feel normal and BE normal. HELP!

en: From a dad in Israel: Hi. We have noticed that our 4 year old daughter cries for every little thing, and seems to have trouble expressing here self verbally at home and kindergarten. For example: the other day at kindergarten she stood holding here cup in the kitchen, until the teacher noticed that she was just waiting there, instead of saying she wants a drink or she walked up to the teacher and showed here left over sandwich and wouldn’t tell the teacher she finished or wants to throw it away, the teacher had to ask here a few guessing questions to which she would nod to until she guessed the right one.
hr: Od tate iz Izraela: Bok. Primijetili smo da naša četverogodišnja kći plače za svaku sitnicu i čini se da ima problema s verbalnim izražavanjem kod kuće i u vrtiću. Na primjer: neki dan u vrtiću stajala je držeći šalicu u kuhinji, sve dok učiteljica nije primijetila da samo čeka, umjesto da kaže da želi piće ili je prišla učiteljici i pokazala ostatak sendviča i nije htjela reći učiteljici da je pojela ili da ga želi baciti, učiteljica joj je morala postaviti nekoliko pitanja na koja bi ona klimala glavom dok ne bi pogodila točan odgovor.

en: For years i hated my sister so much. there are things she does that i really hate. my family is divorce. My sister and i are with my mother. She had surgery years ago due to stress. I listen to everything my mother says, i fix the house when it comes to plumbing, computers, TV, networking, bathroom tiles, ceilings, etc. i work every hard and i really dont ask for anything and i respect others. My mother tells me not to yell at her or tell her what to do and my mother can not discipline her because she is worried she will have surgery again. I cant do anything because i dont want to stress my mother as well. therefore my sister can do what ever she wants.
hr: Godinama sam jako mrzila svoju sestru. Postoje stvari koje ona radi, a koje stvarno mrzim. Moja obitelj je razvedena. Sestra i ja smo s majkom. Operirana je prije mnogo godina zbog stresa. Slušam sve što mi majka govori, popravljam kuću kada je u pitanju vodovod, računala, TV, mreže, pločice u kupaonici, stropovi itd. Radim jako naporno i stvarno ništa ne tražim i poštujem druge. Majka mi kaže da ne vičem na nju ili da joj ne govorim što da radi, a majka je ne može disciplinirati jer se boji da će ponovno imati operaciju. Ne mogu ništa učiniti jer ne želim stresati majku. Stoga moja sestra može raditi što god želi.
en_back: I really hated my sister for years. There are things she does that I really hate. My family is divorced. My sister and I live with my mother. She had surgery many years ago due to stress. I listen to everything my mother tells me, I fix the house when it comes to plumbing, computers, TV, networks, bathroom tiles, ceilings, etc. I work very hard and really don't ask for anything and I respect others. en: I can remember at least 3 incidents as a child, the main one being when I was around 7-9 (we were the same age). hr: Sjećam se barem 3 incidenta iz djetinjstva, a glavni se dogodio kada sam imala oko 7-9 godina (bile smo iste dobi).
