en: From a young man in the U.S.: I wanted to understand the link between the upbringing of one , past experiences ,and past ideologies and how much it can affect ones current reasoning. Does a person have utter and complete freedom to change his reality or would there always be a faction of his brain leading him to a biased conclusion because of his past experience. For example can a person fully understand and change his reality without his brain affecting that decision based on his past. In other words , a person who grew up in a religion , and changes his religion, can he or she be able to fully accept a new belief and formulate a new truth based ok current thinking and not be influenced by the past. In other words how much control do humans have to truly shape their reality based on their logic and not be biased based on any past experiences or at least not make a decison base on that fully.
hr: Od mladića iz SAD-a: Htio sam razumjeti vezu između odgoja, prošlih iskustava i prošlih ideologija te koliko to može utjecati na nečije trenutno razmišljanje. Ima li osoba potpunu slobodu promijeniti svoju stvarnost ili će uvijek postojati dio njezina mozga koji je vodi do pristranog zaključka zbog njezina prošlog iskustva? Na primjer, može li osoba u potpunosti razumjeti i promijeniti svoju stvarnost bez da njezin mozak utječe na tu odluku na temelju njezine prošlosti? Drugim riječima, osoba koja je odrasla u religiji i promijeni svoju religiju, može li biti u stanju u potpunosti prihvatiti novo uvjerenje i formulirati novu istinu na temelju trenutnog razmišljanja, a da na nju ne utječe prošlost? Drugim riječima, koliko kontrole ljudi imaju da istinski oblikuju svoju stvarnost na temelju svoje logike, a da ne budu pristrani na temelju bilo kakvih prošlih iskustava ili barem da ne donose odluku u potpunosti na temelju toga?
en_back: From a young man in the US: I wanted to understand the connection between upbringing, past experiences, and past ideologies, and how much of that can influence someone’s current thinking. Does a person have complete freedom to change their reality, or will there always be a part of their brain that leads them to a biased conclusion because of their past experience? For example, can a person fully understand and change their reality without their brain influencing that decision based on their past? In other words, can a person who grew up in a religion and changes their religion be able to fully embrace a new belief and formulate a new truth based on their current thinking without being influenced by their past? In other words, how much control do people have to truly shape their reality based on their logic, without being biased by any past experiences, or at least not making a decision entirely based on it?

en: I have been with my boyfriend for 4 years and I love him very much. He is a wonderful person and my best friend, but as we are starting to consider getting engaged, I am finding myself very concerned with the negative aspects of our relationship. He is bipolar and not medicated and is not seeing a counselor. He is unpredictable and volatile. One day can be amazing and another I can be afraid or so frustrated I want to just leave. Lately I have found myself looking at other men as potential partners and I feel like I am cheating (even though I have not acted on anything). We have fought about this one issue in our relationship for 4 years, about him not being open about his disorder but blowing up on me and expecting me to just sit back and take it, with no confrontation. I feel that he is not maturing or growing in this relationship. While I love him and genuinely want to grow old with him, I am fearful that this is not intelligent of me to do, nor practical to marry someone who is bipolar and seeking no treatment. What can I do? I have tried talking to him in multiple manners from different angles and he always blows up or hides in himself. I have seen a therapist about this issue and I am still so confused.
hr: S dečkom sam 4 godine i jako ga volim. Divna je osoba i moj najbolji prijatelj, ali kako počinjemo razmišljati o zarukama, jako sam zabrinuta zbog negativnih aspekata naše veze. On je bipolaran, ne uzima lijekove i ne ide kod savjetnika. Nepredvidljiv je i nestabilan. Jedan dan može biti nevjerojatan, a drugi mogu biti uplašena ili toliko frustrirana da jednostavno želim otići. U posljednje vrijeme gledam druge muškarce kao potencijalne partnere i osjećam se kao da varam (iako nisam ništa poduzela). Četiri godine se svađamo oko ovog jednog problema u našoj vezi, oko toga što nije otvoreno govorio o svom poremećaju, već mi se ljuti i očekuje da samo sjedim i trpim, bez sukoba. Osjećam da ne sazrijeva niti raste u ovoj vezi. Iako ga volim i iskreno želim ostarjeti s njim, bojim se da to nije inteligentno od mene, niti je praktično udati se za nekoga tko je bipolaran i ne traži liječenje. Što mogu učiniti? Pokušala sam s njim razgovarati na više načina iz različitih kutova, ali on se uvijek iritira ili povuče u sebe. Bila sam kod terapeuta zbog ovog problema i još uvijek sam jako zbunjena.
en_back: I've been with my boyfriend for 4 years and I love him very much. He's a wonderful person and my best friend, but as we start to think about getting engaged, I'm very concerned about the negative aspects of our relationship. He's bipolar, he's not on medication or seeing a counselor. He's unpredictable and unstable. One day he can be amazing, and the next I can be scared or so frustrated that I just want to leave. Lately I've been looking at other men as potential partners and I feel like I'm cheating (even though I haven't done anything about it). We've been fighting for four years about this one issue in our relationship, that he hasn't been open about his disorder, but instead gets angry at me and expects me to just sit there and suffer, without confrontation. I feel like he's not maturing or growing in this relationship. While I love him and sincerely want to grow old with him, I'm afraid it's not smart of me, nor practical, to marry someone who is bipolar and isn't seeking treatment. What can I do? I've tried talking to him in many different ways from different angles, but he always gets irritated or withdraws. I've been to a therapist about this problem and I'm still very confused.

en: I was professionally diagnosed with ADHD and I’ve struggled with it since childhood. Later I was diagnosed with BPD and GAD, and a different doctor diagnosed BD2. I am certain about the BPD and ADHD, but I think I might actually have MPD (not GAD and BD2) and I’m concerned. I always hate telling my parents or my doctors about problems I think I might have for fear of looking dramatic or “wanting to have problems.” I fit every description in the DSM5, but when I think of MPD I immediately picture the movie Sybil and I know I am not nearly as severe as her. I would like to get help but like I said, I’m afraid it will be seen as one of my “attention seeking behaviors” (but I’m extremely aware of those, and I’ve been making them healthier behaviors as much as I’ve been able) I wouldn’t even know what to do if it were MPD, all the treatment options sound so scary and the thought of being labeled as one of the so-called “crazy” disorders is also scary.
hr: Stručno mi je dijagnosticiran ADHD s kojim se borim od djetinjstva. Kasnije su mi dijagnosticirani granični poremećaj osobnosti (BPD) i generalizirani poremećaj osobnosti (GAD), a drugi liječnik mi je dijagnosticirao BD2. Sigurna sam u vezi BPD-a i ADHD-a, ali mislim da zapravo imam multipli poremećaj osobnosti (MPD) (ne GAD i BD2) i zabrinuta sam. Uvijek mrzim govoriti roditeljima ili liječnicima o problemima za koje mislim da ih imam jer se bojim da ću izgledati dramatično ili da "želim imati problema". Uklapam se u svaki opis u DSM5, ali kad pomislim na MPD, odmah zamišljam filmsku Sybil i znam da nisam ni približno tako ozbiljna kao ona. Voljela bih potražiti pomoć, ali kao što sam rekla, bojim se da će se to smatrati jednim od mojih "ponašanja traženja pažnje" (ali izuzetno sam svjesna toga i trudim se da ih pretvorim u zdravija ponašanja koliko god sam mogla). Ne bih ni znala što učiniti da se radi o MPD-u, sve mogućnosti liječenja zvuče tako zastrašujuće, a i sama pomisao da ću biti označena kao jedan od takozvanih "ludih" poremećaja je zastrašujuća.
en_back: I was professionally diagnosed with ADHD, which I have struggled with since childhood. I was later diagnosed with Borderline Personality Disorder (BPD) and Generalized Personality Disorder (GAD), and another doctor diagnosed me with BD2. I am certain about BPD and ADHD, but I think I actually have Multiple Personality Disorder (MPD) (not GAD and BD2) and I am worried. I always hate telling my parents or doctors about the problems I think I have because I am afraid I will seem dramatic or that I "want to have problems." I fit every description in the DSM5, but when I think of MPD, I immediately picture Sybil from the movie and know that I am not nearly as serious as she is. I would love to get help, but like I said, I am afraid that it will be considered one of my "attention seeking behaviors" (but I am extremely aware of it and try to turn them into healthier behaviors as much as I can). I wouldn't even know what to do if it was MPD, all the treatment options sound so scary, and the very thought of being labeled as one of the so-called "crazy" disorders is terrifying.

en: Hi :) So I recently broke up with my boyfriend and best friend (two months ago). en: I want to know if I’m insane. Sometimes I burst into laughter or tears uncontrollably. I have had times where I have taken sharp surfaces, rubbed them against my wrist to peel the skin off, and I was smiling and laughing. Sometimes I act in a way that resembles someone on drugs and wake up confused. I’m scared of therapist and guidance counselors. I feel very afraid of my mind here and there, it’s usually filled with morbid images. I like the taste of my own blood and have a habit of licking peoples’ skin. Other times, I seem perfectly normal, I’m happy and have a lot of fun. I can fake many emotions easily though, sometime I don’t even know how I’m actually feeling. I just want to be able to understand what’s going on with me. I have problems improving on my own and I think this might be a step forward to getting better. When I care for people, it’s a lot and the slightest things either tick me off or shake to the core, leaving me depressed. I bottle things up all the time and have been suicidal before. I need answers……please.

He feels most comfortable with his sister, my job is stationary my career being 10 years strong with the federal government, I dont see the need to move when he only works in a bar (of all places) but doesnt fully support himself. I feel his mind races and he has coping issues and learning how to move stuff in the past. He had issues with his parents, being mixed race. Now I want him home, I know we have things to work on, but he is more terrified of facing the area where the issues with drugs were. He is up and down, agreed to move back but still having issues with facing the area and the people. His alcohol consumption is terrible, through the roof at least 5 drinks per day and sometimes can finish a gallon in as little as 2 days. I don’t know what to do, how to start dealing with this, I know he has to make the choice, but I don’t know what I can say. I am accused of not understanding, I ask why he flew back to marry me. But I can’t seem to separate him from his sister (who is in the military). There are a few issues yes, but I feel I can’t do much when my sleep is interrupted and I am 1,000 miles away. I’m dealing with his addiction, childish fear and not wanting to leave his old go to person and start our lives, I’m ready to throw in the towel but don’t want to leave.
hr: Moj suprug i ja živimo odvojeno od prvog dana, u različitim državama. Bori se s problemima ovisnosti, ali čini se da mu ne smeta prestati s drogom. Alkohol je i dalje uvelike prisutan. Preselio se kod sestre 1600 kilometara daleko kako bi pobjegao od problema s kojima se ovdje suočava i ponovno započeo život. Na kraju me oženio nakon 3 godine veze. Nije započeo novu karijeru, nije mogao ući u vojsku, pa želim da bude kod kuće. Brine se da će povratak vratiti loše navike, dok ja osjećam da je to bio samo bijeg od stvarnosti i više flaster nego rješavanje problema jer je piće i dalje problem. Najugodnije se osjeća sa sestrom, moj posao je stacionaran, moja karijera u saveznoj vladi traje već 10 godina, ne vidim potrebu za selidbom kada radi samo u baru (od svih mjesta), ali se ne uzdržava u potpunosti. Osjećam da mu misli jure i da ima problema s suočavanjem i učenjem kako premještati stvari u prošlosti. Imao je problema s roditeljima, jer je miješane rase. Sada ga želim kući, znam da imamo na čemu poraditi, ali on se više boji suočiti s područjem gdje su bili problemi s drogom. On se stalno mijenja, pristao se vratiti, ali i dalje ima problema s suočavanjem s područjem i ljudima. Njegova konzumacija alkohola je užasna, probija se kroz plafon, barem 5 pića dnevno, a ponekad popije i galon za samo 2 dana. Ne znam što da radim, kako da se počnem nositi s tim, znam da mora donijeti odluku, ali ne znam što da kažem. Optužuju me da ne razumijem, pitam ga zašto je doletio natrag da me oženi. Ali čini se da ga ne mogu odvojiti od njegove sestre (koja je u vojsci). Ima nekoliko problema, da, ali osjećam da ne mogu puno učiniti kada mi je san prekinut, a ja sam 1600 kilometara daleko. Nosim se s njegovom ovisnošću, djetinjastim strahom i ne želim ostaviti njegovu staru voljenu osobu i započeti naše živote, spremna sam baciti ručnik u kut, ali ne želim otići.
en_back: My husband and I have been living apart since day one, in different states. He struggles with addiction issues, but he doesn't seem to mind quitting drugs. Alcohol is still very much a part of it. He moved in with his sister 1,000 miles away to get away from the problems he faces here and start a new life. He ended up marrying me after 3 years of dating. He didn't start a new career, he couldn't join the military, so I want him home. He worries that moving back will bring back bad habits, while I feel like it was just an escape from reality and more of a band-aid than a solution because drinking is still a problem. He feels most comfortable with his sister, my job is stationary, my career in the federal government has been going on for 10 years, I don't see the need to move when he only works at a bar (of all places), but he's not completely self-sufficient. I feel like his mind is racing and he's having trouble coping and learning how to move things around in the past. He's had problems with his parents, because he's mixed race. Now I want him home, I know we have work to do, but he is more afraid to face the area where the drug problems were. He is constantly changing, he agreed to come back, but he still has trouble dealing with the area and the people. His alcohol consumption is terrible, he is through the roof, at least 5 drinks a day, and sometimes he drinks a gallon in just 2 days. I don't know what to do, how to start dealing with this, I know he has to make a decision, but I don't know what to say. They accuse me of not understanding, I ask him why he flew back to marry me. But I can't seem to separate him from his sister (who is in the military). He has a few problems, yes, but I feel like there is not much I can do when my dream is interrupted and I am 1,000 miles away. I am dealing with his addiction, his childish fear, and I don't want to leave his old loved one and start our lives, I am ready to throw in the towel, but I don't want to leave.

en: I’m a person with various failed friendships, usually i get very close to someone but the friendship only last for like a year, and i always end up thinking that i’m kinda replaceable because for the other person is easier to find new friends. In my last year of college i found a couple of friends that i’m very close with, even when we no longer see each other every day and work in different places we have a very good friendship. The problem is that i’m afraid to lose them, in my line of work there’s not much chance to meet new people and i fear i won’t be able to find new friends if i lose them. When i make a mistake, or do something that affects them, or could make the angry, i freak out, even when they tell me that it is ok i can’t stop thinking that we’ll drift apart. I know that i did nothing so bad and i would forgive them if things where the opposite, but i can’t stop thinking that i messed up, it doesn’t matter how much i want to stop, i can’t. I don’t know what to do. I don’t want to be this anxious all the time.
hr: Osoba sam s raznim neuspjelim prijateljstvima. Obično se jako zbližim s nekim, ali prijateljstvo traje samo godinu dana i uvijek na kraju pomislim da sam nekako zamjenjiva jer je drugoj osobi lakše pronaći nove prijatelje. Na posljednjoj godini fakulteta stekla sam nekoliko prijatelja s kojima sam jako bliska, čak i kada se više ne viđamo svaki dan i radimo na različitim mjestima, imamo jako dobro prijateljstvo. Problem je što se bojim da ću ih izgubiti. U mom poslu nema puno prilika za upoznavanje novih ljudi i bojim se da neću moći pronaći nove prijatelje ako ih izgubim. Kad pogriješim ili učinim nešto što ih utječe ili bi ih moglo naljutiti, poludim. Čak i kad mi kažu da je u redu, ne mogu prestati misliti da ćemo se udaljiti. Znam da nisam učinila ništa tako loše i oprostila bih im da je suprotno, ali ne mogu prestati misliti da sam pogriješila. Nije važno koliko želim prestati, ne mogu. Ne znam što da radim. Ne želim biti ovoliko anksiozan cijelo vrijeme.
en_back: I'm a person with a lot of failed friendships. I usually get really close to someone, but the friendship only lasts a year, and I always end up thinking that I'm somehow replaceable because it's easier for the other person to find new friends. In my senior year of college, I made a few friends that I'm really close to, and even though we don't see each other every day anymore and we work in different places, we have a really good friendship. The problem is that I'm afraid of losing them. There aren't many opportunities to meet new people in my job, and I'm afraid that I won't be able to find new friends if I lose them. When I make a mistake or do something that affects them or might make them angry, I go crazy. Even when they tell me it's okay, I can't stop thinking that we're going to drift apart. I know I didn't do anything that bad and I would forgive them if it were the other way around, but I can't stop thinking that I made a mistake. No matter how much I want to stop, I can't. I don't know what to do. I don't want to be this anxious all the time.

en: Last month I feel like I was doing ok. I was a little depressed (lots of things going on) but, I got a job and I was sooo excited. My first day I satrted feeling dizzy and lightheaded. I went to the dr. and I had a sinus infection. The next couple days I started having panic attacks and lots of anxiety. Then I woke up the next day and was so anxious I couldnt think straight. I didnt feel like “me” anymore like I was walking around in a fog. this kept up for 3 weeks.
hr: Prošli mjesec se osjećam kao da sam dobro. Bila sam malo depresivna (puno se toga događalo), ali dobila sam posao i bila sam jako uzbuđena. Prvog dana sam osjećala vrtoglavicu i omaglicu. en: I have plenty of friends, but I feel very alone. I feel like a constant disappointment to my parents, and I don’t know how to feel comfortable with them. I’ve been eating really really badly and I’ve been having a stomach ache for a couple of days this week. I’ve been procrastinating to the point where i rarely do my homework. Also, I love doing theater, yet i haven’t been able to get into the mindset of memorizing lines. Is this just the season, a phase in my growing up, or is something legitimately wrong with me?
hr: Imam puno prijatelja, ali osjećam se jako usamljeno. Osjećam se kao stalno razočaranje svojim roditeljima i ne znam kako se osjećati ugodno s njima. en: I am usually a very happy individual and throughout most of the day I am quite upbeat and friendly. However, I find that sometimes I will become irritable for little reason. If my shoes feel weird, if I can’t find something, just setting up my computer, or for no reason at all, can cause me to become irritated. It is not to the point where I am yelling and screaming, but I feel a strong urge to break something or to exert force of some kind.
hr: Obično sam vrlo sretna osoba i veći dio dana sam prilično optimističan i prijateljski raspoložen. Međutim, ponekad postanem razdražljiv bez ikakvog razloga. Ako mi cipele čudno stoje, ako ne mogu nešto pronaći, samo postavljanje računala ili bez ikakvog razloga, to me može iritirati. Ne dolazi do te mjere da vičem i vrištem, ali osjećam snažnu potrebu da nešto razbijem ili da primijenim neku vrstu sile.

en: I have had strange experiences for a while now, but when I spoke to one of my friends about it they were pretty freaked out. I see figures made of shadows, and hear footsteps most of the time. I also sometimes hear the voices of two demons. I know that logically it is unlikely for these things to be real, but it is still terrifying. I have tried to be more aware of these things and ignore them while they are happening but I have had very little success. When things get really scary I can talk to my friend and ask if she doesn’t think that is what is really happening, but I don’t want to rely on her every time I think there is a sniper on the hill behind my house. For the most part I have been able to keep it a secret and be normal, but my other friends are starting to notice that something is wrong. I have taken a few online screenings just to get an idea of what to be aware of in case things get worse and I am starting to get worried that something is actually wrong. I am just generally confused and scared. I don’t know if I am overreacting. I just want someone to tell me what to do. Should I try and talk to a therapist about this or should I just keep relying on friends and hope that it goes away?
hr: Već neko vrijeme imam čudna iskustva, ali kad sam o tome razgovarala s jednom od svojih prijateljica, bile su prilično prestravljene. Pokušala sam biti svjesnija tih stvari i ignorirati ih dok se događaju, ali imala sam vrlo malo uspjeha. Kad stvari postanu stvarno strašne, mogu razgovarati s prijateljicom i pitati je misli li da se to stvarno događa, ali ne želim se oslanjati na nju svaki put kad pomislim da je snajperist na brdu iza moje kuće. Uglavnom sam to uspjela držati u tajnosti i biti normalna, ali moje druge prijateljice počinju primjećivati da nešto nije u redu. Napravila sam nekoliko online pregleda samo da bih dobila ideju na što trebam paziti u slučaju da se stvari pogoršaju i počinjem se brinuti da nešto zapravo nije u redu. Općenito sam zbunjena i uplašena. Ne znam pretjerujem li. Samo želim da mi netko kaže što da radim. en: Within this month, some extremely frighting and scary things have been occurring to me. I have begun to hear noises in my head saying different things with different accents, they tell me different things all the time. Once I remember seeing a man in the forest all alone, and hearing voices stating to murder him. At some times, definitely a lot in my school, it feels like the entire day was one minute, I sometimes literally cannot remember anything I just did. It is extremely terrifying. I feel tired all the time, I rarely, if ever, smile. I am barely passing school, mostly Ds and C minuses – I dont use a single second of my day on studying or doing homework, and seeing as I barely can function in my school environment, I barely understand anything I am supposed to be learning, and I really dont care. I am always silent all day, and when confronted I simply answer with the quickest response I can.
hr: Unutar ovog mjeseca, događaju mi se neke izuzetno zastrašujuće i strašne stvari. Počeo sam čuti zvukove u glavi koji govore različite stvari s različitim naglascima, stalno mi govore različite stvari. Jednom sam se sjetio da sam vidio čovjeka u šumi sasvim samog i čuo glasove koji su rekli da će ga ubiti. Ponekad, definitivno često u mojoj školi, osjećam se kao da je cijeli dan trajao jednu minutu, ponekad se doslovno ne mogu sjetiti ničega što sam upravo učinio. To je izuzetno zastrašujuće. Stalno se osjećam umorno, rijetko se, ako ikada, smiješim. Jedva prolazim školu, uglavnom s dvojkama i minusima - ne koristim ni jednu sekundu svog dana za učenje ili pisanje zadaće, a budući da jedva funkcioniram u školskom okruženju, jedva razumijem išta što bih trebao učiti i stvarno me nije briga. Uvijek sam cijeli dan tih, a kada se suočim sa situacijom, jednostavno odgovorim najbržim što mogu.

en: This is all probably going to sound really strange, but I just really feel like something is not right. There is a blur in my life that I absolutely cannot remember. I can remember right before I started school, when I was 4 or 5. Then there is about 2 or 3 years that is completely lost. I have never though much about until here of late. It all centers around a place that me and my family stayed. It was a duplex and I don’t remember living there at all. I remember that house before that and the one after. The first memory I have of the house we lived in after the duplex is me and my older brother “exploring ourselves”. It was more then a “you show me yours and I’ll show you mine.” I feel so ashamed about that and cannot figure out for the life of me WHY we did that?? I can remember touching my stuffed animals in inappropriate places and even doing the same things with another girl that was my age. I started having sex at a very early age, around 12, and haven’t stopped since. In fact, that is really the only risk taking behavior I have ever really had. From somewhere, and I don’t know where, it has been imprinted on my mind that if you care someone, that’s how you show it. I have never had any other experiences with my brother since that very young age, but I know that we did it more then once. I am just wondering were all this was coming from. I recently started having dreams of my brother and me now. I know, it sounds sick, but I can’t help it. This is also something that we have never talked about since it happened. I have also been having like these flashbacks of this man that used to come to the house that I don’t remember living in. (I know he was there from what my brothers have told me) In the scenarios, I am a little girl, around 5,6 or 7. I am yelling for my daddy, (my parents were separated at the time we lived in this house also) and a man in a police uniform, tucking me into bed and telling me to quit yelling and the he loved me and putting his hand over my mouth. I started to investigate this man and he was arrested in 2001 for 7 counts of indecent liberties with a minor spanning from 1976 to 2001. The accusers were girls that he babysat for other women and his daughter. I am just wondering if maybe my mind has blocked out the span of those years for a reason. Is that possible?? Is that why me and brother were “exploring” each other?? It would in fact explain a lot of my behavior. I have anxiety issues now, but I to scared to see a therapist. I am getting married in May and I am scared that if this comes out, he will think differently of me because of what occurred with one of my brothers?? It is possible I am freaking out over nothing??

hr: Dakle, upoznala sam svoje najbolje prijateljice na svijetu kad sam krenula na fakultet. Konačno sam pronašla grupu ljudi s kojima sam se uspjela sprijateljiti i sve je bilo super prošle godine. Međutim, ove godine su se sve okrenule protiv mene. Ignoriraju me kad me vide i prolaze pored mene, što je nezrelo i bolno. Najgore od svega je što me sada i moja najbolja prijateljica mrzi. Našla sam se s njom da se pomirimo, ali to nije odvelo nikamo, a nije mi baš rekla što sam učinila da bih izazvala ovu promjenu.
en_back: So, I met my best friends in the world when I started college. I finally found a group of people I could be friends with and everything was great last year. However, this year they all turned on me. They ignore me when they see me and walk past me, which is immature and hurtful. The worst part is that now my best friend hates me too. I met with her to make up, but it didn't go anywhere, and she didn't really tell me what I did to cause this change.

en: From the U.S.: Hi. This story has been in the making most of my life and seems a vicious circle that I cannot solve to both our liking & to my annoyance. All my life, I have felt mostly ignored & criticized by my mother. She came here from Europe at 21 after meeting my American father in Europe and marrying here. They were educated, but, I feel, “missed” the 60’s revolution and both seemed a little “square.” They also seemed to have learned much, but I always felt a little deprived for some reason.
hr: Iz SAD-a: Bok. Ova priča stvarala je veći dio mog života i čini se kao začarani krug koji ne mogu riješiti, koliko god nam se svidjelo, a koliko god to bilo moje nezadovoljstvo. Cijeli život osjećala sam se uglavnom ignorirano i kritizirano od strane svoje majke. Došla je ovamo iz Europe s 21 godinom nakon što je upoznala mog američkog oca u Europi i ovdje se udala. Bili su obrazovani, ali, osjećam, "propustili" revoluciju 60-ih i oboje su djelovali pomalo "uglađeno". Također se činilo da su puno naučili, ali uvijek sam se iz nekog razloga osjećala pomalo uskraćeno.
en_back: From the USA: Hi. This story has shaped most of my life and seems like a vicious cycle that I can't seem to break, no matter how much we like it and how much I dislike it. My whole life I've felt mostly ignored and criticized by my mother. She came here from Europe at the age of 21 after meeting my American father in Europe and got married here. They were educated but, I feel, "missed" the revolution of the 60s and both seemed a bit "polished". They also seemed to have learned a lot, but I always felt a bit deprived for some reason.

en: I’m in a long term relationship, over 10 years, with my partner. We are a lesbian couple. From the begining of our relationship she has been telling me that she would be a bad partner. I always refused this. She is a wonderfull partner and I love her dearly. I also feel that she does. We do have some difficulties but usually are able to talk it through. Now, she has a loss of desire for me. Our sex life is almost inexistant.
hr: U dugogodišnjoj sam vezi sa svojom partnericom, preko 10 godina. Lezbijski smo par. Od početka naše veze mi je govorila da bi bila loša partnerica. Uvijek sam to odbijao. Naš seksualni život gotovo da ne postoji.

I always rejected that. She is a wonderful partner and I love her very much. I feel like she loves it too. We have some difficulties, but we usually manage to solve them by talking. en: It all started with me intaking a syrop that contained THC, I was told that I would not experience any feelings of being high but it would help with my pain. ( I have pelvic floor dysfunction). As I took it, about two hours later I started to get a Panic attack , my heart would beat really fast and I thought I was going insane and dizzy. After that I had a feeling of derealization, not depersonalization that I did not feel like in my body, but that everything seemed weird strange, and in a fog almost dream like. I thought that this is what THC caused me to feel like (Never did it before). Next day I was fine but I found out my co-worker has passed away due to heroin overdose. Since then I had no symptomps of anything. Two months later, I started to get panic attacks and anxiety after my boyfriend’s fathers death. I had heart palapation, dizziness and lightheadeness. Soon this went away as well but these intrusive thoughts won’t go away. Especially at night time where I think what if I am not really here, everything seems strange and weird around me. Not as much as that night that I took the syroup but sort of. IT’s just these thoughts are scaring me and make me think that I might be getting schizophrenia , or the onset of it…This is all I can think about, I try to go out and there are days where I have better days and seem happy and normal but then the worse days come too. I also thought I have schizophrenia because as I was falling asleep I would have a lot of chaotic thoughts in my head, not voices but random song lyrics popping up , scaring me to think I’m going crazy. Please I need some advice.
hr: Sve je počelo tako što sam popila sirup koji je sadržavao THC. Rečeno mi je da neću osjetiti nikakav osjećaj napušenosti, ali da će mi pomoći kod boli (imam disfunkciju zdjeličnog dna). Dok sam ga uzimala, otprilike dva sata kasnije počela sam dobivati napad panike, srce mi je jako ubrzano kucalo i mislila sam da ludim i da mi se vrti u glavi. Nakon toga imala sam osjećaj derealizacije, ne depersonalizacije koju nisam osjećala u svom tijelu, već da mi se sve činilo čudno, čudno i u magli, gotovo kao san. Mislila sam da je to ono što mi THC uzrokuje (nikad prije nisam to učinila). Sljedeći dan bila sam dobro, ali sam saznala da je moj kolega preminuo zbog predoziranja heroinom. Od tada nisam imala nikakvih simptoma. Dva mjeseca kasnije, počela sam dobivati napade panike i anksioznost nakon smrti oca mog dečka. Imala sam palpaciju srca, vrtoglavicu i omaglicu. Nakon što sam saznala da je to anksioznost, naučila sam se nositi s tim. Međutim, derealizacija se ponovno dogodila i zbog nje sam se osjećala kao u stalnoj magli. Uskoro je i to prošlo, ali te nametljive misli neće nestati. Pogotovo noću kada razmišljam što ako nisam stvarno ovdje, sve mi se čini čudno i čudno oko mene. Ne toliko kao te noći kada sam popila sirup, ali nekako. Samo me te misli plaše i tjeraju me da mislim da možda dobivam shizofreniju, ili početak iste... To je sve o čemu mogu razmišljati, pokušavam izaći i ima dana kada imam bolje dane i činim se sretno i normalno, ali onda dođu i gori dani. Također sam mislila da imam shizofreniju jer bih dok bih tonula u san imala puno kaotičnih misli u glavi, ne glasove, već nasumične tekstove pjesama koji su se pojavljivali, plašeći me da mislim da ludim. Molim vas, trebam savjet.

I hung up with him around 2am and told him to sleep soon because we had a date planned for early the next morning. I hung out with that friend a couple days later and she told me that they had stayed up until 4am texting and that he told her not to tell me. U početku nije bio ni iskren u vezi svega dok ga nisam pitala zašto je izbrisao njihov razgovor s telefona i vidjela FaceTime snimke u njegovom popisu poziva. Trebalo mu je oko sat vremena da mi konačno kaže sve što se dogodilo, razmišljala sam o prekidu jer sam se osjećala toliko izdano. Znao je da bi trebao biti iskren i da više nikada ne laže, ali opet je to učinio prije otprilike dva tjedna. Rekao mi je da se dopisuje s mojim prijateljem o njihovom zajedničkom interesu za glazbu i bila sam dobro i sretna što je iskren. Prekinula sam vezu oko 2 ujutro i rekla mu da uskoro spava jer smo imali planiran spoj za rano sljedeće jutro. S tom prijateljicom sam se družila nekoliko dana kasnije i rekla mi je da su ostali budni do 4 ujutro dopisujući se i da joj je rekao da mi ne govori. Suočila sam se s njim, priznao je i rekao da mi planira reći te večeri. Ponovno je izbrisao njihov razgovor i morala sam ga dobiti od nje, usput, nije mi poslala važne dijelove pa više nismo prijateljice. I ponovno je lagao, opet ništa strašno, ali rekao je da će mi poslati slike svoje hrane dok je na odmoru. Nema ga tjedan dana i ništa, stalno ga gnjavim za njih i rekao je da mi je poslao jedan od svojih deserta. Znala sam da nešto nije u redu pa sam mu se suočila i rekla mu da ne laže, ali on je nastavio i htio je sve odglumiti ZA SLIKANJE. Ne znam što da radim jer nije prestao, kako ću znati da hoće kad to kaže ako do sada nije bilo istina. Ne želim izgubiti našu vezu, ali rekla sam mu da neću izlaziti s nekim tko mi neće prestati lagati.

en: From a teen in the U.S.: I recently have begun to notice that my behavior has become rather strange. One second I could be happy, then next I could be sad, anxious, paranoid, or angry within an instant. I don’t understand how I feel. I’m assuming this begun at a much younger age than now, such as when I was probably ten or maybe eleven. I went through some sexual abuse as a child for 4-5 years (from the ages of 4-9) before it finally ended. And I’m happy to say that everything and everyone is safe and fine now that the abuser is gone. Since then I have visited a therapist, but it was brief and it was quite some time ago. Possibly 5-6 years ago. Most of the questions they asked at the therapy office were questions about my abuser for legal reasons; what he did, how it was done, etc. I was probably 9 or ten by then.
hr: Od tinejdžerice iz SAD-a: Nedavno sam počela primjećivati da je moje ponašanje postalo prilično čudno. U jednom trenutku mogla sam biti sretna, a zatim u sljedećem mogla biti tužna, tjeskobna, paranoična ili ljuta u trenutku. Ne razumijem kako se osjećam. Pretpostavljam da je to počelo u puno mlađoj dobi nego sada, primjerice kada sam imala vjerojatno deset ili možda jedanaest godina. Kao dijete sam prošla kroz seksualno zlostavljanje 4-5 godina (od 4. do 9. godine) prije nego što je konačno završilo. I drago mi je što mogu reći da su sada svi sigurni i dobro sada kada zlostavljača više nema. Od tada sam posjećivala terapeuta, ali to je bilo kratko i prije dosta vremena. Možda prije 5-6 godina. en: From a 25 year old woman in India: Known the guy for 15 years, a real solid friendship where we discussed everything, but he left the state without goodbye. I was always the shoulder to cry on when the series of unending girlfriends that waltzed through his life left their sting behind, late night calls, pit stops at my place despite my parents, I was there for him when I needed me the most. I nursed him through his rather troubled engagement much to his parents relief.

en: I’ve been a homebound agoraphobic for 3.5 years. I want to get help, but obviously can’t get to a therapist’s office, and I don’t work and my family has no money so I can’t afford to pay for therapy. My family also doesn’t want me in therapy, and since I live with them, my only option would be online treatment. I’ve tried to search the web for what I can do, but there doesn’t seem to be any help for someone in my situation except to just deal with it myself. If I could deal with it by myself, I would have in the last 3 years. What do I do?
hr: Već 3 i pol godine sam vezan za kuću i imam agorafobiju. Želim potražiti pomoć, ali očito ne mogu doći do terapeuta, a ne radim i moja obitelj nema novca pa si ne mogu priuštiti terapiju. Moja obitelj me također ne želi na terapiji, a budući da živim s njima, jedina opcija mi je online liječenje. Pokušao sam pretražiti internet kako bih saznao što mogu učiniti, ali čini se da nema nikakve pomoći za nekoga u mojoj situaciji osim da se sam nosim s tim. Da se mogu sam nositi s tim, nosio bih se s tim u posljednje 3 godine. Što da radim?

en: From the U.S.: I have been in an unhappy marriage for five years, since our daughter was born to be exact. Although she makes me feel so lucky and a very happy mom, my husband and I seemed to agree to be a team and work together for the sake of her happiness. I always thought that doesn’t matter how difficult our relationship gets, I would never leave him because I don’t want our daughter to grow up with divorced parents. I promised this to myself, until I met “The One”.
hr: Iz SAD-a: Pet godina sam u nesretnom braku, točnije otkako nam se rodila kći. Iako se zbog nje osjećam tako sretnom i kao vrlo sretna mama, čini se da smo se suprug i ja složili da budemo tim i radimo zajedno za njezinu sreću. Uvijek sam mislila da bez obzira koliko naša veza postane teška, nikada ga neću ostaviti jer ne želim da naša kći odrasta s razvedenim roditeljima. To sam obećala samoj sebi, sve dok nisam upoznala "Onog Pravog".
en_back: From the USA: I have been in an unhappy marriage for five years, more precisely since our daughter was born. en: My Fiancé changes when we are around his family. He isn’t very nice to me, and he talks to me like I am “stupid.” He just does not give me the time of day. He won’t look at me when he tells me a story, I find out WAY more when he is talking to his mom about what he did this week, and when I ask, he barely says anything. His attitude is very negative towards me. I don’t understand why he is doing this. I have tried to talk to him about it, but he says “I don’t know what you are talking about” — I will try to give him an example of something he said that isn’t nice, and he will just shrug his shoulders and says, I don’t know. I think that since we are going to be a family in about 7 days, I should be able to talk to him wherever we are, and he treats me with the same respect he does when we are at home. I don’t understand. Please help. I don’t know how to talk to him (which he is VERY stubborn) and no matter how i bring up a subject, he will immediately get defensive and he will shut down. it is hard. I just need ways to communicate effectively, and help him understand he needs to respect me no matter who is around…including his best friend who he follows like a puppy…. ah!
hr: Moj zaručnik se mijenja kad smo u blizini njegove obitelji. Nije baš ljubazan prema meni i razgovara sa mnom kao da sam "glupa". Jednostavno mi ne posvećuje vrijeme. Neće me pogledati kad mi priča priču, puno više saznam kad razgovara s mamom o tome što je radio ovaj tjedan, a kad ga pitam, jedva išta kaže. Njegov stav je vrlo negativan prema meni. Ne razumijem zašto to radi. Pokušala sam razgovarati s njim o tome, ali on kaže "Ne znam o čemu pričaš" - pokušat ću mu dati primjer nečega što je rekao, a što nije lijepo, a on će samo slegnuti ramenima i reći, ne znam. Mislim da budući da ćemo za otprilike 7 dana biti obitelj, trebala bih moći razgovarati s njim gdje god se nalazimo, a on se prema meni odnosi s istim poštovanjem kao kad smo kod kuće. Ne razumijem. Molim vas, pomozite. Ne znam kako razgovarati s njim (a on je JAKO tvrdoglav) i bez obzira kako pokrenem temu, on će odmah zauzeti obrambeni stav i zatvoriti se. Teško je. Samo mi trebaju načini da učinkovito komuniciram i pomognem mu da shvati da me treba poštovati bez obzira na to tko je u blizini... uključujući i njegovog najboljeg prijatelja kojeg slijedi kao štene... ah!

en: From a teen guy in the U.S.: I’ve always been uncomfortable with affection. When I feel like I’ve been wronged I can completely cut someone out of my life and could care less about them. Even some of my close relatives. I realized that I don’t really care at all about things I should care about. I realized today that if my parents were to sit me down and tell me that they didn’t love me at all, I would absolutely not mind at all. I wouldn’t be hurt at all and the first thought that would come to mind would be, if I could still live in my house. I don’t think this is normal or is it?
hr: Od tinejdžera iz SAD-a: Oduvijek mi je bilo neugodno kad sam bio u kontaktu s naklonošću. Kad osjetim da mi je netko učinio nepravdu, mogu nekoga potpuno izbaciti iz svog života i ne mariti za njega. Čak ni za neke od bliskih rođaka. Shvatio sam da me uopće nije briga za stvari do kojih bih trebao brinuti. Danas sam shvatio da mi, kad bi me roditelji smjestili i rekli mi da me uopće ne vole, apsolutno ne bi smetalo. Ne bih se nimalo osjećao povrijeđeno, a prva pomisao koja bi mi pala na pamet bila bi: mogu li još uvijek živjeti u svojoj kući. Mislim da ovo nije normalno ili je?
en_back: From a teenager in the US: I have always been uncomfortable with being in contact with affection. en: From the U.S.: My sister and I were physically and emotionally abused and emotionally neglected by our mom when we were little. (It isn’t still happening. My sister has had no contact with our mom since she was nine.) For me, it caused problems that eventually led to severe depression and several suicide attempts.
hr: Iz SAD-a: Moja sestra i ja smo bile fizički i emocionalno zlostavljane i emocionalno zanemarivane od strane naše mame kad smo bile male. (To se više ne događa. Moja sestra nije imala kontakt s našom mamom otkad je imala devet godina.) Kod mene je to uzrokovalo probleme koji su na kraju doveli do teške depresije i nekoliko pokušaja samoubojstva.
en_back: From the USA: My sister and I were physically and emotionally abused and emotionally neglected by our mother when we were little. (This doesn't happen anymore. My sister hasn't had contact with our mother since she was nine.) For me, it caused problems that eventually led to severe depression and several suicide attempts.

en: From a woman in the U.S.: I left an emotionally abusive relationship a year ago. It has left tremendous damage mentally. My ex may be a narcissist but this is not diagnosed. Through my thirteen years with him I formed into this very submissive, people-pleasing person. I had the tendencies to please people before him but after him it is the most noticeable, in my opinion, trait about me.
hr: Od žene iz SAD-a: Prije godinu dana sam izašla iz emocionalno nasilne veze. To je ostavilo ogromnu mentalnu štetu. Moj bivši možda jest narcis, ali to se ne dijagnosticira. Tijekom trinaest godina s njim formirala sam se u vrlo pokornu osobu koja ugađa ljudima. Imala sam tendenciju ugađati ljudima prije njega, ali nakon njega to je, po mom mišljenju, najuočljivija osobina kod mene.
en_back: From a woman in the US: I got out of an emotionally abusive relationship a year ago. It left a huge mental scar. My ex may have been a narcissist, but it's not diagnosed. Over the course of thirteen years with him, I developed into a very submissive, people-pleaser. I had a tendency to be a people-pleaser before him, but after him, that's, in my opinion, the most noticeable trait in me.

en: From Canada: My mother and father were addicted to drugs my whole childhood (father still is, mom’s not but still messed up from it) and me and my brother grew up having a tumultuous childhood and also were in fosters homes off and on. But now I’m older and I’ve made a really great life for myself and I’m trying to do some self-improvement on emotions.
hr: Iz Kanade: Moji roditelji su cijelo djetinjstvo bili ovisni o drogama (otac još uvijek jest, mama nije, ali smo i dalje jako poremećeni zbog toga) i brat i ja smo odrasli u burnom djetinjstvu, a povremeno smo bili i u udomiteljskim obiteljima. Ali sada sam stariji i stvorio sam si stvarno sjajan život te pokušavam raditi na samousavršavanju po pitanju emocija.
en_back: From Canada: My parents were addicted to drugs my entire childhood (my dad still is, my mom isn't, but we're still very disturbed by it) and my brother and I grew up in a turbulent childhood, and we were in foster care at times. But now I'm older and have created a really great life for myself and I'm trying to work on my emotional self-improvement.

en: My ex is having a baby with someone else after just one month of ending our relationship. I’ve been having a very difficult time dealing with this. When me and my ex-boyfriend broke up we tried to be friends and hang out from time to time one day out of know where he told me we couldn’t be friends anymore he didn’t give me a clear explanation he just told me he didn’t want me to start to cling to him again. We haven’t spoken since. Later I found out the girl was pregnant at that same particular time and he had made her his girlfriend. I guess she was a rebound gone wrong and he is just taking responsibility for his actions but it still hurts.
hr: Moj bivši će dobiti dijete s nekim drugim nakon samo mjesec dana od prekida naše veze. Jako mi je teško nositi se s tim. Kad smo se bivši dečko i ja razišli, pokušavali smo biti prijatelji i povremeno se družiti. Jednog dana, ne znajući, rekao mi je da više ne možemo biti prijatelji, ali mi nije dao jasno objašnjenje, samo mi je rekao da ne želi da se ponovno počnem lijepiti za njega. Od tada nismo razgovarali. Kasnije sam saznala da je djevojka bila trudna u isto vrijeme i da ju je učinio svojom djevojkom. Pretpostavljam da je to bio povratni udarac koji je krenuo po zlu i da on samo preuzima odgovornost za svoje postupke, ali i dalje boli.
en_back: My ex is having a baby with someone else just a month after we broke up. I'm having a really hard time dealing with this. When my ex and I broke up, we tried to be friends and hang out occasionally. en: From a teenager in the U.S.: About a year ago, I moved from Tennessee back to the state I was born in. It wasn’t until then, that I began to notice more and really start to understand why I have never felt normal. I believe I have some kind of Anxiety and/or Depression problem. I have yet to see a professional, but I plan on it soon. As of right now, I’m looking for some uplifting advice to get me through until then. I’ve struggled with these issues my whole life. I’m just now realizing what it is and how it has affected me. As I go on in life, I’m struggling more than I should with who I am, and what to do. I’ve hit rock bottom and I’m down to the point where I literally can only say,”I just don’t know anymore”.
hr: Od tinejdžera iz SAD-a: Prije otprilike godinu dana preselio sam se iz Tennesseeja natrag u državu u kojoj sam rođen. Tek tada sam počeo primjećivati više i stvarno shvaćati zašto se nikada nisam osjećao normalno. Mislim da imam neku vrstu problema s anksioznošću i/ili depresijom. Još nisam posjetio stručnjaka, ali planiram to uskoro. Trenutno tražim neke ohrabrujuće savjete koji će mi pomoći da prebrodim to do tada. Cijeli život se borim s tim problemima. Tek sada shvaćam što je to i kako je to utjecalo na mene. Kako idem dalje u životu, borim se više nego što bih trebao s tim tko sam i što učiniti. Dotaknuo sam dno i došao sam do točke u kojoj doslovno mogu samo reći: "Jednostavno više ne znam".

en: From a teen in the U,S.: I fit the DSM-5 Criteria for BPD. I scored 88 for BPD on sanity score connected to psychcenteral, and the borderline test connected to psychcentral gave me a score of 43 when 33+ is supposed to be generally severe. I know that BPD isn’t usually diagnosed in adolescents but recent studies are starting to show that symptoms actually start at this age.
hr: Od tinejdžera iz SAD-a: Udovoljavam DSM-5 kriterijima za granični poremećaj osobnosti. Postigao sam 88 bodova za granični poremećaj osobnosti na temelju rezultata psihijatrijskih istraživanja, a granični test povezan s psihijatrijskim istraživanjem dao mi je rezultat 43, dok se 33+ bodova općenito smatra teškim. Znam da se granični poremećaj osobnosti obično ne dijagnosticira kod adolescenata, ali nedavne studije počinju pokazivati da simptomi zapravo počinju u toj dobi.
en_back: From a teenager in the US: I meet the DSM-5 criteria for borderline personality disorder. I scored 88 for borderline personality disorder based on psychiatric research results, and the Borderline Test associated with psychiatric research gave me a score of 43, while 33+ is generally considered severe. I know that borderline personality disorder is not usually diagnosed in adolescents, but recent studies are starting to show that symptoms actually begin at that age.

en: My son has been at basic training for almost two months and I’m having a hard time adjusting. I’m at the point where I don’t even want to go to bed or turn the lights off. He’s left before for brief periods, but now it’s obviously for good. I’m so proud of him but I can’t seem to adjust. I don’t do much other than work. If I’m not working, I just sit at home. I can go days without human contact. I was diagnosed with depression and social anxiety disorder back in 2002, so it’s an ongoing issue, but it’s worse now that I’m alone. I keep telling myself I don’t want to be here anymore. I have no emotional attachment to the place I’m currently living. I have the urge to move closer to where my son is, or where he’ll be based. As a parent, we know this day will come. I guess I didn’t really plan for it or think about how it might affect me. People tell me to move on with my life, But I honestly don’t want to. Whenever I picture my son, I picture him as a young child. I guess I can’t get over the past.
hr: Moj sin je na osnovnoj obuci već gotovo dva mjeseca i teško mi je prilagoditi se. Došla sam do točke u kojoj ne želim ni ići u krevet ni gasiti svjetla. Prije je odlazio na kratko, ali sada je očito zauvijek. Jako sam ponosna na njega, ali čini se da se ne mogu prilagoditi. Ne radim puno osim posla. Ako ne radim, samo sjedim kod kuće. Mogu provesti dane bez ljudskog kontakta. Dijagnosticirana mi je depresija i socijalni anksiozni poremećaj još 2002. godine, tako da je to stalan problem, ali sada je gore kada sam sama. Stalno si govorim da više ne želim biti ovdje. Nemam emocionalnu vezanost za mjesto gdje trenutno živim. Imam potrebu preseliti se bliže mjestu gdje je moj sin ili gdje će biti smješten. Kao roditelj, znamo da će ovaj dan doći. Pretpostavljam da ga nisam baš planirala niti razmišljala o tome kako bi to moglo utjecati na mene. Ljudi mi govore da krenem dalje sa svojim životom, ali iskreno ne želim. Kad god zamišljam svog sina, zamišljam ga kao malo dijete. Pretpostavljam da ne mogu preboljeti prošlost.

en: Six months ago I went on a camp with some friends. I slept with one of my best friends which was in a long-lasting relationship. We both enjoyed it and wanted to continue with that. We both knew it was a bad and immoral thing, but the pleasure was above all the morality. But I started to fall madly in love with him. Every time I saw him, touched him, kissed him I was feeling so good and appreciated. Nobody ever has given me a feeling like that. And we did not have a single quarrel in all this time. Everything was perfect except the fact that he was cheating on his girlfriend with me and our relationship was a secret. But he started to feel guilty about this relationship about a month ago and wanted to break up with me. I could not stand such a thing and I asked him to give me another chance to make him forget his girlfriend. It did not work out. He is trying to convince me that he is not the right person for me and he is in love with his girlfriend, although he tells me “I love you” every day. I am trying to be the perfect girlfriend for him and do anything he asks, but he still loves the other one more. What can I do to have him? Or should I forget him? I can’t forget him because I love him so much. He is my first true love. I can’t let this behind. (age 20, from Romania)
hr: Prije šest mjeseci bila sam u kampu s prijateljima. Spavala sam s jednom od svojih najboljih prijateljica s kojom sam bila u dugotrajnoj vezi. Oboje smo uživali i htjeli smo nastaviti s tim. Oboje smo znali da je to loše i nemoralno, ali zadovoljstvo je bilo iznad svega morala. Ali počela sam se ludo zaljubljivati u njega. Svaki put kad bih ga vidjela, dodirnula, poljubila, osjećala sam se tako dobro i cijenjeno. Nitko mi nikada nije pružio takav osjećaj. I nismo se niti jednom posvađali u cijelom ovom vremenu. Sve je bilo savršeno osim činjenice da je varao svoju djevojku sa mnom i naša veza je bila tajna. Ali on se prije otprilike mjesec dana počeo osjećati krivim zbog te veze i htio je prekinuti sa mnom. Nisam mogla podnijeti takvo što i zamolila sam ga da mi da još jednu priliku da ga natjeram da zaboravi svoju djevojku. Nije uspjelo. Pokušava me uvjeriti da nije prava osoba za mene i da je zaljubljen u svoju djevojku, iako mi svaki dan govori "Volim te". Pokušavam biti savršena djevojka za njega i učiniti sve što traži, ali on i dalje više voli onu drugu. Što mogu učiniti da ga imam? Ili da ga zaboravim? Ne mogu ga zaboraviti jer ga toliko volim. On je moja prva prava ljubav. Ne mogu ovo pustiti iza sebe. (20 godina, iz Rumunjske)

He's my first true love. I can't let this go. (20 years old, from Romania)

en: Hello, it’s a quite pleasure to meet you. I’ve just recently realized that I think I may have a problem. It never struck me as odd before, yet it was so obvious. There are two different “me’s” besides the normal me. They are two extremes. There is the extremely obsessive and overly emotional one that I have nicknamed “Loony.” Then there is the emotionally empty, intellectual, and analytical one that is the “Bored” one.
hr: Pozdrav, drago mi je što smo se upoznali. Nedavno sam shvatio da mislim da imam problem. Nikad mi se prije nije činilo čudnim, a opet je bilo tako očito. Postoje dva različita "ja" osim normalnog mene. To su dvije krajnosti. Tu je onaj izrazito opsesivan i pretjerano emotivan kojeg sam nazvao "Luđak". Zatim postoji emocionalno prazan, intelektualan i analitičan, onaj koji se "dosađuje".
en_back: Hello, nice to meet you. I recently realized that I think I have a problem. It never seemed strange to me before, and yet it was so obvious. There are two different "me"s besides the normal me. They are two extremes. There is the extremely obsessive and overly emotional one that I have called "The Madman." Then there is the emotionally empty, intellectual and analytical one, the one that is "bored."

en: A therapist I saw for about 4 years when I was 18 has stayed in touch with me for the last 4 decades. She did things that were above and beyond therapy such as loaning me money when I finished college and relocated for work. She also shared her failing marriage with me, about 20 years ago. Sometimes she is very open and shares a lot, and other times she shuts down.
hr: Terapeutkinja koju sam posjećivala oko 4 godine kada sam imala 18 godina ostala je u kontaktu sa mnom posljednja četiri desetljeća. Činila je stvari koje su bile iznad i izvan terapije, poput posuđivanja novca kada sam završila fakultet i preselila se zbog posla. Također je sa mnom podijelila svoj propali brak, prije otprilike 20 godina. Ponekad je vrlo otvorena i puno toga dijeli, a ponekad se zatvori.
en_back: The therapist I saw for about 4 years when I was 18 has stayed in touch with me for the past four decades. She did things that were above and beyond therapy, like borrowing money when I graduated from college and moved for work. She also shared with me her failed marriage, about 20 years ago. Sometimes she's very open and shares a lot, and sometimes she closes down.

en: From India: Hello. I am just a normal girl who happens to see a movie about a certain actor approximately 10 years from now. My father and i have always shared a loving and fulfilling relationship but my mother is not mentally healthy, so sometimes i feel like there’s a gap that needs to be filled within my heart. What started as a very innocent crush like feeling ended up being my worst nightmare. Obsession.
hr: Iz Indije: Bok. Ja sam samo obična djevojka koja je slučajno pogledala film o određenom glumcu za otprilike 10 godina. Moj otac i ja smo oduvijek imali punu ljubavi i ispunjen odnos, ali moja majka nije mentalno zdrava, pa ponekad osjećam kao da postoji praznina u mom srcu koju treba popuniti. Ono što je počelo kao vrlo nevin osjećaj zaljubljenosti završilo je kao moja najgora noćna mora. Opsesija.
en_back: From India: Hi. I'm just an ordinary girl who happened to watch a movie about a certain actor about 10 years ago. My father and I have always had a loving and fulfilling relationship, but my mother is not mentally healthy, so sometimes I feel like there's a void in my heart that needs to be filled. What started as a very innocent feeling of infatuation ended up being my worst nightmare. Obsession.

en: From the U.S.: My seven year old son had a friend over the other day and they were playing in his room. My husband went to check on them and heard my boy asking his friend if he could “lick his butt.” His friend told him no and my son told him he would give him all the money in his pocket if he agreed.
hr: Iz SAD-a: Moj sedmogodišnji sin je neki dan imao prijatelja u posjeti i igrali su se u njegovoj sobi. Moj muž je otišao provjeriti kako su i čuo je mog sina kako pita svog prijatelja može li mu "polizati guzicu". Prijatelj mu je rekao ne, a moj sin mu je rekao da će mu dati sav novac iz džepa ako pristane.
en_back: From the US: My 7-year-old son had a friend over the other day and they were playing in his room. My husband went to check on them and overheard my son asking his friend if he could "lick his ass." The friend said no, and my son told him he would give him all the money in his pocket if he agreed.

en: From the U.S.: I am 31 years old and female. When I was 23 I would work at a retail store night shift, would hear mumbling, laughing, vulgarity and talking all night, at the time I assumed it was just other people or co workers working in the aisle next to me. I would go outside and smoke at 3 am in the morning, the parking lot was empty, would still hear them, but, no one was there. Parking lot was empty. This happened night after night.
hr: Iz SAD-a: Imam 31 godinu i žena sam. Kad sam imala 23 godine radila sam noćnu smjenu u trgovini, cijelu noć bih čula mrmljanje, smijeh, vulgarnost i razgovor, u to vrijeme sam pretpostavljala da su to samo drugi ljudi ili kolege koji rade u prolazu pored mene. Izašla bih van i pušila u 3 ujutro, parkiralište je bilo prazno, i dalje bih ih čula, ali nikoga nije bilo tamo. Parkiralište je bilo prazno. To se događalo iz noći u noć.
en_back: From the USA: I am 31 years old and female. When I was 23 I worked the night shift at a grocery store, all night long I would hear mumbling, laughing, vulgarity and talking, at the time I assumed it was just other people or colleagues working in the aisle next to me. I would go outside and smoke at 3am, the parking lot was empty, I could still hear them, but no one was there. The parking lot was empty. This happened night after night.

en: I’m a 25-year-old male attracted to 16-year olds. I thought this was normal since lots of men are into teen girls. 16 is the age of consent in my state. Recently, people were calling this person online a pedophile for being attracted to 17-year olds despite only being 20.
hr: Imam 25 godina i privlače me 16-godišnjakinje. Mislio sam da je to normalno jer se mnogi muškarci zanimaju za tinejdžerice. U mojoj državi je 16 godina dob pristanka. Nedavno su ljudi ovu osobu na internetu nazivali pedofilom jer je privlače 17-godišnjakinje iako ima samo 20 godina.
en_back: I'm 25 years old and I'm attracted to 16-year-old girls. I thought it was normal because many men are interested in teenage girls. In my country, the age of consent is 16. Recently, people online called this person a pedophile because he's attracted to 17-year-old girls even though he's only 20.

en: From the U.S.: I recently started seeing a psychiatrist for ADHD. She also offers psychotherapy and comes from an ISTDP and CBT approach. I am now on medication for that and requested therapy to help me understand and manage some of the issues my ADHD has caused. During my first 30m med management appointment yesterday, it became clear I was more depressed than I had considered myself during intake.
hr: Iz SAD-a: Nedavno sam počela posjećivati psihijatricu zbog ADHD-a. Ona također nudi psihoterapiju i dolazi iz ISTDP i KBT pristupa. Sada uzimam lijekove za to i zatražila sam terapiju kako bih bolje razumjela i upravljala nekim od problema koje je uzrokovao moj ADHD. Tijekom mog prvog pregleda u 30m medicinskom odjelu jučer, postalo je jasno da sam depresivnija nego što sam mislila da sam tijekom prijema.
en_back: From the USA: I recently started seeing a psychiatrist for my ADHD. She also offers psychotherapy and comes from an ISTDP and CBT approach. I am currently on medication for it and have sought therapy to better understand and manage some of the problems my ADHD is causing. During my first appointment at the 30m medical ward yesterday, it became clear that I was more depressed than I thought I was when I was admitted.

en: Not sure where to start to be honest, I’ll try my best. 8th grade and before: I wanted to become a mechanic and have my own shop since I’m good at that and am interested in that field. I now would be in 11th grade. I quit school, trying for me GED soon. Waiting to hear if I get help for money soon. I no longer know what I want to do since I want to live a better life: Nice house, car or two, eating organic, have a social life, etc. I want to talk to girls make friends and am social but I like phobic. I don’t have much help from anyone. Currently live with my mom and brother but in an eyesore of a neighborhood, low-end public housing and have no vehicle or jobs. I also want to live more of a free life instead of working most of my days. I feel as if I need a plan because I feel lost. I’ve had therapists but never felt like I had true help, I don’t need medications I would benefit from a life coach most likely. I don’t know what career path I want to take. I know I want to be happy doing it, have a lot of free time to enjoy life, have enough money to have the life I want. Maybe I could have my own business but nothing really interests me. I don’t want to go to college all that much, I don’t have money as it is nor want any more debt than I already have. Since a young age I always wanted to be famous, but of course I have terrible anxiety and am not good at talking to people or being in front of crowds. I know there’s nothing to be afraid of but still get the fears. Also I’m stressed out with this but also with my mom who is a smoker and heavy soda drinker my father is doing some time and recovering from drug addiction. A lot of family is like this. I want my parents to be around awhile so I can afford to give them the life they never had or never gave my younger brother and me. My relationship with my brother and mother isn’t good either. I don’t have any friends or girlfriend.to sum it up I is very different than the rest of my generation and need guidance. In advance, Thanks for the help.
hr: Iskreno, nisam siguran odakle početi, dat ću sve od sebe. 8. razred i prije: Htio sam postati mehaničar i imati vlastitu radionicu jer sam dobar u tome i zanima me to područje. Sada bih trebao biti u 11. razredu. Napustio sam školu, uskoro ću pokušati dobiti GED. Čekam da čujem hoću li uskoro dobiti pomoć za novac. Više ne znam što želim raditi jer želim živjeti bolji život: lijepu kuću, auto ili dva, jesti organsku hranu, imati društveni život itd. Želim razgovarati s djevojkama, sklapati prijateljstva i društven sam, ali imam fobiju od toga. Nemam puno pomoći ni od koga. Trenutno živim s mamom i bratom, ali u ružnom susjedstvu, u jeftinom socijalnom smještaju i nemam vozilo ni posao. Također želim živjeti slobodnijim životom umjesto da većinu dana radim. Osjećam se kao da mi treba plan jer se osjećam izgubljeno. Imao sam terapeute, ali nikad nisam osjećao da imam pravu pomoć, ne trebaju mi lijekovi, najvjerojatnije bi mi koristio life coach. Ne znam kojim karijernim putem želim krenuti. Znam da želim biti sretan radeći to, imati puno slobodnog vremena za uživanje u životu, imati dovoljno novca za život kakav želim. Možda bih mogao imati vlastiti posao, ali ništa me zapravo ne zanima. Ne želim ići na fakultet, nemam novca ionako niti želim više dugova nego što već imam. Od malih nogu uvijek sam želio biti slavan, ali naravno da imam strašnu anksioznost i nisam dobar u razgovoru s ljudima ili nastupanju pred mnoštvom. Znam da se nema čega bojati, ali i dalje osjećam strahove. Također sam pod stresom zbog ovoga, ali i zbog svoje mame koja je pušačica i veliki konzument gaziranih pića, a moj otac je u zatvoru i oporavlja se od ovisnosti o drogama. Puno obitelji je takvo. Želim da moji roditelji budu neko vrijeme u blizini kako bih si mogao priuštiti život kakav nikada nisu imali ili koji nikada nisu pružili mom mlađem bratu i meni. Moj odnos s bratom i majkom također nije dobar. Nemam prijatelja ni djevojke. Ukratko, jako sam drugačiji od ostatka svoje generacije i trebam smjernice. Unaprijed hvala na pomoći.
en_back: Honestly, I'm not sure where to start, I'll give it my all. 8th grade and before: I wanted to become a mechanic and have my own shop because I'm good at it and I'm interested in it. I should be in 11th grade now. I dropped out of school, I'm going to try to get my GED soon. I'm waiting to hear if I'll get financial aid soon. I don't know what I want to do anymore because I want to live a better life: a nice house, a car or two, eat organic food, have a social life, etc. I want to talk to girls, make friends, and I'm social, but I have a phobia of it. I don't have much help from anyone. I currently live with my mom and brother, but in a bad neighborhood, in cheap public housing, and I don't have a car or a job. I also want to live a more independent life instead of working most of the day. I feel like I need a plan because I feel lost. I've had therapists, but I never felt like I had real help, I don't need medication, I could probably use a life coach. I don't know what career path I want to take. I've always wanted to be famous since I was a little girl, but of course I have terrible anxiety and I'm not good at talking to people or performing in front of crowds. I know there's nothing to be afraid of, but I still feel the fears. I want my parents to be around for a while so I can afford the life they never had or never gave my younger brother and me. My relationship with my brother and mother is also not good. I don't have any friends or girlfriends. In short, I'm very different from the rest of my generation and I need guidance. Thanks in advance for your help.

en: From Canada: I got married a month ago and since the wedding, I keep thinking about the things that I didn’t plan properly. Biggest one being the guest list for the wedding. I decided not to invite some people because my fiance was only inviting his close friends but we had a huge wedding and enough room to fit more people especially since some guests didn’t even show up. I think I was also pressed for time and just didn’t bother inviting some people out of being lazy and wanting to cut down on my workload.
hr: Iz Kanade: Udala sam se prije mjesec dana i od vjenčanja stalno razmišljam o stvarima koje nisam pravilno isplanirala. Najveća je popis gostiju za vjenčanje. Odlučila sam ne pozvati neke ljude jer je moj zaručnik pozivao samo svoje bliske prijatelje, ali imali smo ogromno vjenčanje i dovoljno mjesta za više ljudi, pogotovo jer se neki gosti nisu ni pojavili. Mislim da sam bila i u stisci s vremenom pa se jednostavno nisam potrudila pozvati neke ljude iz lijenosti i želje da smanjim obim posla.

en: I work 7 days a week and I am sometimes tired. (I also suffer from adenomyosis so I feel uncomfortable at times) He waits for me to get home and expects me to go directly in the room. This is far from romantic and it is frustrating because I feel like a rag doll! Furthermore his kids are always home so there is zero privacy. He threatens to leave me because of this. He has 3 days off to rest and relax and I feel run down and would like to take off my shoes before. Am I crazy? I would love to have a normal sex life but it is hard because we do not live together and i work 70hrs a week. I am sure if we lived together it would be easier but we dont. I dont know what to do. I feel hurt when he is mean after i say no. He turns it around on me. I need advice.
hr: Radim 7 dana u tjednu i ponekad sam umorna. (Također patim od adenomioze pa se ponekad osjećam neugodno.) Čeka da dođem kući i očekuje da odmah uđem u sobu. To je daleko od romantičnog i frustrirajuće je jer se osjećam kao krpena lutka! Štoviše, njegova djeca su uvijek kod kuće pa nemam nikakvu privatnost. Prijeti da će me ostaviti zbog toga. Ima 3 slobodna dana za odmor i opuštanje, a ja se osjećam iscrpljeno i htjela bih se prije toga izuti. Jesam li luda? Voljela bih imati normalan seksualni život, ali teško je jer ne živimo zajedno, a radim 70 sati tjedno. Sigurna sam da bi bilo lakše da živimo zajedno, ali ne živimo. Ne znam što da radim. Osjećam se povrijeđeno kad je zao nakon što kažem ne. On to okrene protiv mene. Trebam savjet.

en: I don’t know where to begin. It seems stupid just to come here and write about what’s wrong with me. Or what I think is wrong with me. All my problems seem made up by myself. I ocassionally feel depressed, but I don’t deserve to be depressed. I have everything in my life to be happy: family, some friends, upper middle class upbringing, material things. I feel guilty and ungrateful.
hr: Ne znam odakle da počnem. Čini se glupo samo doći ovdje i pisati o tome što nije u redu sa mnom. Ili što mislim da nije u redu sa mnom. Čini se da sam sve svoje probleme sama izmislila. Povremeno se osjećam depresivno, ali ne zaslužujem biti depresivna. Imam sve u životu da bih bila sretna: obitelj, neke prijatelje, odgoj više srednje klase, materijalne stvari. Osjećam se krivom i nezahvalnom.

en: Let me begin with the symptoms I have had all my life. Ever since I was little, I have been anxious in large crowds, especially in crowds full of strangers, so much so that I spend a lot of my free time, not at work or school, at home. Time outside in situations with people, I find myself struggling to find a topic of conversation, or continuing on with a subject. I find myself saying things at the wrong time, or reacting oddly to other people’s reactions. At times, I seem to incorrectly read people’s emotions, whether spoken or not, and I tend to get angry and frustrated when there is no need to be. Because of this, I am conflicted, because when I am at home, I wish to be out with people doing something, but when I am around my friends and family, though I do enjoy it for some time, I end up wishing I were back at home.
hr: Dozvolite mi da počnem sa simptomima koje imam cijeli život. Otkad sam bila mala, osjećala sam anksioznost u velikim gužvama, posebno u gužvama punim stranaca, toliko da većinu svog slobodnog vremena provodim kod kuće, ne na poslu ili u školi. Kad sam vani u situacijama s ljudima, teško mi je pronaći temu za razgovor ili nastaviti s temom. Govorim stvari u krivo vrijeme ili čudno reagiram na reakcije drugih ljudi. Ponekad se čini da krivo čitam emocije ljudi, bilo da su izgovorene ili ne, i sklona sam ljutiti se i frustrirati kada za to nema potrebe. Zbog toga sam u konfliktu, jer kada sam kod kuće, želim biti vani s ljudima i nešto raditi, ali kada sam okružena prijateljima i obitelji, iako neko vrijeme uživam u tome, na kraju poželim da sam opet kod kuće.
en_back: Let me start with the symptoms I've had my whole life. Ever since I was little, I've felt anxious in large crowds, especially crowds full of strangers, so much so that I spend most of my free time at home, not at work or school. When I'm out in situations with people, I have a hard time finding a topic to talk about or continuing the conversation. I say things at the wrong time or react strangely to other people's reactions. Sometimes I seem to misread people's emotions, whether they're spoken or unspoken, and I tend to get angry and frustrated when there's no need to. This makes me conflicted, because when I'm at home, I want to be out with people and doing something, but when I'm surrounded by friends and family, even though I enjoy it for a while, I end up wishing I was home again.

en: I love my boyfriend dearly but his problem is relating to money. My boyfriend has savings and his own home. I have nothing. But he makes a big issue that I have nothing. He doesn’t like spending. I have to mostly buy food and drinks when we go out. I do not mind, but if he does buy me something he takes it back if he is annoyed. If he does buy a gift he expects me to give him one in return. I do not enjoy going shopping with him as it always ends up with us arguing. He then points out I don’t buy him anything. He does not live with me, but stays every night with me. I have a family to take care of and he does not hardly contribute. But now when he does decide to contribute, he eventually takes it back, even if it is just bread. Sometimes when he buys me a drink he will take it back half way down, or remind me later that he bought me a drink.
hr: Jako volim svog dečka, ali njegov problem je vezan uz novac. Moj dečko ima ušteđevinu i vlastitu kuću. Ja nemam ništa. Ali on pravi veliki problem od toga što nemam ništa. Ne voli trošiti. Uglavnom moram kupovati hranu i piće kad izlazimo. Ne smeta mi, ali ako mi nešto kupi, vrati to ako je ljut. Ako kupi poklon, očekuje da mu ja uzvratim. Ne volim ići u kupovinu s njim jer se uvijek završi svađom. Onda on ističe da mu ništa ne kupujem. Ne živi sa mnom, ali svaku noć ostaje kod mene. Imam obitelj o kojoj se moram brinuti i on gotovo da ne doprinosi. Ali sada, kad odluči doprinijeti, na kraju to vrati, čak i ako je to samo kruh. Ponekad, kad me časti pićem, vrati ga na pola ili me kasnije podsjeti da mi je platio piće.

hr: Bok..u teškoj sam situaciji i ne znam što da radim. Upoznala sam ovog tipa prije mjesec dana i razgovarali smo. Zapitali smo se nešto duboko i pitao me sviđa li mi se, a ja sam rekla da, što mi se sviđa, i pitala sam ga sviđam li mu se, a on je rekao da. I rekao je da bih mu bila buduća djevojka. Pa, neki dan sam ga pitala bi li ikada izašao sa mnom, a njegova sestra je odgovorila: "Hej dušo, ovo je Mattova sestra i pitala sam ga tko si ti i ne miješam se u njegove poslove, ali vidim da si mu upravo poslala poruku i samo želim reći da samo želi biti prijatelj s tobom i ništa više. Ne želi povrijediti tvoje osjećaje." Pa, rekla sam ne, nisi, a ona je rekla da će ti poslati poruku kad se vrati iz trgovine, a on mi je poslao poruku i rekao: "Moja sestra je rekla da si poslao poruku, rekao sam: 'Jesi li ti rekla što je rekla?' Rekao je otprilike što je rekla i ja sam mu rekla, a on je rekao: 'Da, premlad si za mene, ali se nadam da ćeš i dalje biti prijatelj sa mnom.' Rekla sam naravno... ali ono što ne razumijem je zašto bi se prije družio sa mnom i poljubio me i rekao da mu se sviđam i sve to, ali kad ga sestra pita tko sam, on jednostavno kaže da mu se ne sviđam. en: From a teen in the U.S.: Ok so, sometimes I feel really lonely and like i cant talk to anyone else about what i am feeling, because it is really hard to put into words. i have some days where i am fine but other days where i get really sad. i feel unwanted by people and like i always give more than other people and feel under-appreciated.
hr: Od tinejdžerice iz SAD-a: U redu, ponekad se osjećam jako usamljeno i kao da ne mogu ni s kim drugim razgovarati o tome što osjećam, jer je to stvarno teško izraziti riječima. Imam neke dane kada sam dobro, ali druge dane kada sam jako tužna. Osjećam se neželjeno od ljudi i kao da uvijek dajem više od drugih ljudi i osjećam se podcijenjeno.
