I have some days when I'm good, but other days when I'm really sad. I feel unwanted by people and like I'm always giving more than other people and I feel undervalued.

en: I’ve recently received a microphone in the mail that I had boughten about a week ago. Trying it out, I feel so scared and distracted. I feel as if the more I express myself, the more frightened I am to express myself, and I think it’s all because of what I did when I was in middle school. Back in middle school, I used to be a huge cyberbully, and I used a microphone to express such meanness. Now I regret such actions, and that makes me too scared to say anything again.
hr: Nedavno sam poštom primio mikrofon koji sam kupio prije otprilike tjedan dana. Isprobavajući ga, osjećam se tako uplašeno i rastreseno. Osjećam se kao da što se više izražavam, to se više bojim izraziti se, i mislim da je sve to zbog onoga što sam radio dok sam bio u osnovnoj školi. U osnovnoj školi sam bio veliki cyberbully i koristio sam mikrofon da izrazim takvu zlobu. Sada žalim zbog takvih postupaka i to me previše boji da bih išta ponovno rekao.

I feel like the more I express myself, the more afraid I am to express myself, and I think it's all because of something I did when I was in elementary school. In elementary school, I was a huge cyberbully and used the microphone to express such malice. I regret those actions now and it scares me too much to say anything again.

en: I have come a long way since 2008 when I had a complete mental health breakdown. I have finally gotten control over my action. I am winning my daily battle more almost all the time, or I was. I lost everything in 2008 including the ability to control my actions, for years my emotions ran everything. I didn’t want to hurt anyone. I hate taking medication but I was begging for anything that might help, only to be told I would be on so many pills I wouldn’t know whether I was coming or going. So I closed myself away from the world for fear I would react to anything in a negative way. I wanted to give up, but couldn’t. I tried everything available to me in town and in cities I knew well so would not put any more stress on myself then I had already by forcing myself to go to theses places. That went on for years I would force myself to leave my home go to wherever my new hope for help was but nothing worked. I left my home less and less scared of what I might do. T hen 3 and a half years ago something changed. I was starting win more and more. I had no help no support but the strength that I lost in 2008 was coming back. I struggled yeah but I was doing it. My life was getting better. Soon I felt strong enough to work. However I was turned down every single time. I was still winning my battle for control over my actions and thoughts but I did give up hope of having a job and moving out of a town that is for me toxic.
hr: Daleko sam napredovala od 2008. godine kada sam doživjela potpuni mentalni slom. Konačno sam dobila kontrolu nad svojim postupcima. Gotovo uvijek pobjeđujem u svojoj svakodnevnoj bitci, ili sam barem pobjeđivala. 2008. sam izgubila sve, uključujući i sposobnost kontrole svojih postupaka, godinama su mi emocije upravljale svime. Nisam htjela nikoga povrijediti. Mrzim uzimati lijekove, ali sam molila za bilo što što bi mi moglo pomoći, samo da bi mi rekli da ću uzimati toliko tableta da neću znati dolazim li ili odlazim. Zato sam se zatvorila od svijeta iz straha da ću na bilo što reagirati negativno. Htjela sam odustati, ali nisam mogla. Pokušala sam sve što mi je bilo dostupno u mjestima i gradovima koje sam dobro poznavala kako se ne bih više opterećivala prisiljavajući se da idem na ta mjesta. To se nastavilo godinama, prisiljavala sam se napustiti svoj dom i ići gdje god je bila moja nova nada za pomoć, ali ništa nije djelovalo. Napuštala sam svoj dom sve manje i manje uplašena što bih mogla učiniti. Tada se prije 3 i pol godine nešto promijenilo. Sve više sam pobjeđivala. Nisam imala nikakvu pomoć, nikakvu podršku, ali snaga koju sam izgubila 2008. vraćala se. Borila sam se, da, ali sam uspijevala. Moj život je postajao sve bolji. Ubrzo sam se osjećala dovoljno snažnom da radim. Međutim, svaki put sam bila odbijena. I dalje sam dobivala bitku za kontrolu nad svojim postupcima i mislima, ali sam odustala od nade da ću imati posao i preseliti se iz grada koji je za mene toksičan.
en_back: I have come a long way since 2008 when I had a complete mental breakdown. I finally gained control over my actions. I almost always win my daily battle, or at least I used to. In 2008 I lost everything, including the ability to control my actions, for years my emotions ruled everything. I didn’t want to hurt anyone. I hate taking medication, but I prayed for anything that would help me, only to be told that I would be taking so many pills that I wouldn’t know if I was coming or going. So I closed myself off from the world for fear of reacting negatively to anything. I wanted to give up, but I couldn’t. I tried everything available to me in the places and cities that I knew well so that I wouldn’t have to burden myself with forcing myself to go to those places anymore. This continued for years, forcing myself to leave my home and go wherever my new hope for help was, but nothing worked. I left my home less and less afraid of what I might do. Then, 3 and a half years ago, something changed. I was winning more and more. I had no help, no support, but the strength I had lost in 2008 was coming back. I was struggling, yes, but I was succeeding. My life was getting better. Soon, I felt strong enough to work. However, I was rejected every time. I continued to win the battle to control my actions and thoughts, but I gave up hope of getting a job and moving out of a city that was toxic to me.

en: From a 13 year old in the U.S.: Hi, I don’t know if I’m too young for this, but I’ve always had trouble determining what I truly believe in. Almost all of my actions, thoughts, and beliefs conflict with one another. Sometimes talking to people is easy while other times it’s impossible. Sometimes I’m unbelievably emotional while other times I just can’t seem to understand people. I always considered this normal and human, especially for someone my age, but it’s gotten to the point where I honestly can’t tell the difference between what I really believe in and what I think I do.
hr: Od 13-godišnjaka iz SAD-a: Bok, ne znam jesam li premlad za ovo, ali oduvijek sam imao problema s određivanjem u što istinski vjerujem. Gotovo svi moji postupci, misli i uvjerenja su u međusobnom sukobu. Ponekad je razgovor s ljudima jednostavan, dok je drugi put nemoguć. Ponekad sam nevjerojatno emotivan, dok drugi put jednostavno ne mogu razumjeti ljude. Uvijek sam to smatrao normalnim i ljudskim, posebno za nekoga mojih godina, ali došlo je do točke u kojoj iskreno ne mogu razlikovati ono u što istinski vjerujem od onoga što mislim da vjerujem.

I've always thought it was normal and human, especially for someone my age, but it's gotten to the point where I honestly can't tell the difference between what I truly believe and what I think I believe.

hr: U posljednje vrijeme osjećam se iritirano cijeli dan, jako mrzim ljude, ljude koje nikad nisam upoznao. Ponekad zbog toga kako izgledaju, ponekad zbog toga kako se ponašaju. Gledam svijet oko sebe i osjećam se kao da nikada neću biti sretan, zbog mržnje kojom sam ispunjen.

en: I am wondering what stage of breakup I am in. Breakup occurred three weeks ago, had been five years with him. I’m starting to accept the reality, but I’m wondering if I’m still in denial and have the other four stages of grief to go through. He (former boyfriend) blindsided me with the breakup, it was sudden. I have spent many days being extremely upset and wanting him to contact me and tell me he regrets that decision. While I still hope he eventually regrets it, I feel like I’m starting to accept he is gone and let go. This would mean I skipped the anger, bargaining, and depression stages of grief and I can’t imagine I’d be in acceptance this early. However, I don’t feel like I’m in shock as much, and I am consciously telling myself the relationship is over and I need to move on. Does this mean I’m still in denial? Or does it seem like I am transitioning to a different stage?
hr: Pitam se u kojoj sam fazi prekida. Prekid se dogodio prije tri tjedna, prošlo je pet godina od moje veze. Počinjem prihvaćati stvarnost, ali se pitam jesam li još uvijek u poricanju i imam li još četiri faze tugovanja kroz koje moram proći. On (bivši dečko) me iznenadio prekidom, bilo je iznenada. Provela sam mnogo dana izuzetno uzrujana i željela sam da me kontaktira i kaže mi da žali zbog te odluke. Iako se još uvijek nadam da će na kraju požaliti, osjećam kao da počinjem prihvaćati da je otišao i da me pustio. To bi značilo da sam preskočila faze ljutnje, pregovaranja i depresije tugovanja i ne mogu zamisliti da bih se tako rano prihvatila. Međutim, ne osjećam se kao da sam toliko u šoku i svjesno si govorim da je veza gotova i da moram krenuti dalje. Znači li to da sam još uvijek u poricanju? Ili mi se čini kao da prelazim u drugu fazu?
en_back: I'm wondering what stage of the breakup I'm in. The breakup happened three weeks ago, it's been five years since my relationship. While I still hope he'll regret it in the end, I feel like I'm starting to accept that he left and let me go. That would mean I've skipped the anger, bargaining, and depression stages of grief, and I can't imagine accepting myself so early. However, I don't feel like I'm in that much of a shock and I'm consciously telling myself that the relationship is over and I need to move on. Does that mean I'm still in denial? Or does it feel like I'm moving into another stage?

en: From a teen in the U.S.: I don’t think I am antisocial because I am always with my friends, it’s just that I would rather be alone. But if I could be my complete self around my friends I wouldn’t be writing this. When it comes to family I don’t mind being with them, but I just would rather be alone when it comes to my friends.
hr: Od tinejdžera iz SAD-a: Ne mislim da sam antisocijalan jer sam uvijek s prijateljima, samo bih radije bio sam. Ali kad bih mogao biti potpuni svoj u blizini prijatelja, ne bih ovo pisao. Kad je riječ o obitelji, ne smeta mi biti s njima, ali jednostavno bih radije bio sam kad su u pitanju moji prijatelji.
en_back: From a teenager in the US: I don't think I'm antisocial because I'm always with friends, I just prefer to be alone. en: My daughter (age 22) was recently diagnosed as bipolar. She had a major panic attack and was hospitalized for 2 weeks, which was very traumatic. After her release, she stayed on her meds and went to sessions with a therapist for a few weeks, but recently stopped taking all meds, and refuses to see her therapist. She seemed ok for a little while, but is not showing signs of mania again. If I say anything about seeking treatment, she accuses me of not understanding her and what is happening to her. She is very paranoid and worries about her safety all the time. I need to know how to talk to her and what to do to get her into treatment. Any suggestions?? thanks
hr: Mojoj kćeri (22 godine) nedavno je dijagnosticiran bipolarni poremećaj. Imala je jaki napadaj panike i bila je hospitalizirana 2 tjedna, što je bilo vrlo traumatično. Nakon puštanja iz bolnice, nastavila je uzimati lijekove i išla na seanse s terapeutom nekoliko tjedana, ali je nedavno prestala uzimati sve lijekove i odbija ići kod terapeuta. Činilo se da je neko vrijeme dobro, ali više ne pokazuje znakove manije. Ako kažem išta o traženju liječenja, optuži me da je ne razumijem i što joj se događa. Vrlo je paranoična i stalno brine za svoju sigurnost. Moram znati kako razgovarati s njom i što učiniti da je uključim u liječenje. Imate li kakve prijedloge?? Hvala

en: I am 21 female and have not had any friends for 10 years. I am high achieving and am scoring really highly in my degree in Economics at LSE. It is not the work that is getting me down, it is companionship. When I was at school I cared but not as much about not having any friends because I was the highest performing so I saw it as necessary to my success. Now I am at university my peers around me all have social lives and boyfriends and so it hurts more now. I tried making friends but seem to have a perpetual block for the last 10 years. I don’t think I will kill myself – a desire for success and my family and my dog are protective factors. I used to snort cocaine every week or so when I was 11-14. I have been clean of everything inc alcohol and cigarettes for last 7 years. A psychiatrist noticed at a play group when I was 6 I seemed not to look at other kids and not know what to do. What should I do? (age 21, from UK)
hr: Imam 21 godinu i nisam imala prijatelja već 10 godina. Postižem visoke rezultate i postižem odlične rezultate na studiju ekonomije na LSE-u. Nije posao ono što me obeshrabruje, već društvo. Kad sam išla u školu, bilo mi je stalo, ali ne toliko do toga što nemam prijatelja jer sam bila najbolja, pa sam to smatrala nužnim za svoj uspjeh. Sada sam na sveučilištu, svi moji vršnjaci oko mene imaju društveni život i dečke, pa me sada više boli. Pokušala sam steći prijatelje, ali čini se da imam stalnu blokadu posljednjih 10 godina. Ne mislim da ću se ubiti - želja za uspjehom, a moja obitelj i pas su zaštitni faktori. Šmrkala sam kokain otprilike svaki tjedan kad sam imala 11-14 godina. en: Okay before I start I’m 20yrs old, living with my mother and father and 4 other siblings. As far back as I can remember, he constantly abused me mentally and physically to the point I’m traumatized and scared all over my body espically my face. I don’t want to turn to the police because he is only like that with me alone. he is a great father to my siblings. However when it comes to me, he hates me. He said I was a curse brought upon him by god and one day he will kill me and get rid of it. and indeed he abused me to the point I blanked out and passed out, and became crippled for a while. I would move out, but I don’t have the money for that nor do I have the job. Whenever I get I job, I take too many “sick days” out because of the bruises and scarring on my face are hard to hide. also because of the same reason I’m failing college. en: For nearly two years, I’ve dealt with increasingly worse anxiety symptoms. The biggest issue is my inability to sleep when I am away from home, including difficulties sleeping in my own dorm. I’ve dealt with these sleeping issues for over a year and generally find that when I can’t sleep, my mind focuses on all the things wrong with the room I’m in (too quiet, too hot, etc). I’m also constantly going through a mental list of assignments, meetings, and events, and rewriting the list in my planner each day. Usually, I just run through the list in my head, but I have also noticed that I will speak out loud to myself while walking to and from class and run through the list while making a plan of what order to complete those tasks. I’ll run through this order multiple times, typically until I get to wherever I’m going or encounter other people because I’m worried they will judge me for speaking to myself. Even when I’ve accomplished the tasks I set out to do on a particular day, I still find myself thinking about the items on that list and panicking about how much more I have to do. As a result, I feel as if I can never fully relax. I’m always worried that I’m going to forget something on that list and that something bad will happen because I don’t complete that particular thing. I also find that I have difficulty concentrating because I’m constantly thinking about these things. When I have difficulty concentrating and feel really anxious about something, generally experiencing a heavy feeling in my chest and difficulty breathing, I end up picking at the skin around my nails, and on particularly bad days, I do this until they bleed. Although I generally fear that others will judge me for my actions, I find that picking helps me calm down and refocus myself. While my worries about school are generally my main focus, I often find myself worrying about my relationships as well, particularly that my friends don’t really like me and that I don’t actually have feelings for my boyfriend. I’ve recently begun to fear that I have OCD rather than just anxiety. I’ve brought some of these topics up to my doctor, but should I voice my worries that the anxiety I experience seems to mirror some aspects of OCD? (From the USA)

Priznala mi je da bi voljela da je imala samo mog najstarijeg brata, a ne i srednjeg brata ili mene. Izabrala je muškarce i veze prije svoje djece i pustila nas je sve da nas netko drugi odgaja prije ili kasnije tijekom života. Nikada ništa ne traži od mog najstarijeg brata niti ga za išta krivi. Traži stvari od mog drugog brata i zahtijeva ili manipulira stvarima od mene. Voljela bi da moja braća više razgovaraju s njom i mrzi što ja toliko razgovaram s njom. Kad mi je srednji brat zamalo umro, posjetila ga je samo jednom u bolnici i pomogla mu što je manje mogla kad je otišao kući. Ona i ja smo pričale o svemu i viđale se svaki dan. Imam slomljen kuk, moja je krivnja, kad sam joj rekla, plakala je i rekla da će odmah doći u bolnicu, a zatim je 45 minuta pričala samo o svojoj vezi i nije došla. Od tada me je posjećivala samo kada bi je zamolili za pomoć i samo ako je imala drugi izgovor da bude u blizini. Nazvala je samo jednom svojom voljom, 3 tjedna nakon operacije, cijelo vrijeme je pričala o sebi, nevoljko me pitala kako sam, a zatim me pitala koristim li još uvijek hodalicu za kretanje. Trebala sam raditi za nju ovo ljeto, što bi joj puno olakšalo viđanje s dečkom, ali kada sam joj rekla da ću dugo biti na bolničkom krevetu, nije izrazila nikakvo suosjećanje niti priznanje, već je promijenila temu na sebe i spustila slušalicu. To je bilo prije 3 tjedna i od tada je nisam čula. Oprostite što je dugo i isprekidano činjenicama, ali svaki uvid u to što se događa ili što bih trebala učiniti stvarno bi mi pomogao. She asks things of my other brother and demands or manipulates things from me. She wishes my brothers would talk to her more and hates that I talk to her so much. When my middle brother almost died, she only visited him once in the hospital and helped him as little as she could when he went home. She and I talked about everything and saw each other every day. I have a broken hip, it's my fault, when I told her she cried and said she would come to the hospital right away, then spent 45 minutes talking about her relationship and didn't come. I was supposed to work for her this summer, which would have made it much easier for her to see her boyfriend, but when I told her I would be in the hospital for a long time, she didn't express any sympathy or acknowledgement, she just changed the subject to myself and hung up. I have these erotic fantasies too that I’ve had for my whole life. To me they aren’t disturbing though. I thoroughly enjoy them but I don’t want to go to jail. This part could be PTSD related too but idk. I don’t hear voices either. So do you think it’s at all possible I have PTSD?
hr: Mislim da imam simptome. Cijeli sam život znala da sam empat i još uvijek nekako vjerujem u to, ali ono što sam otkrila jest da ne mogu stvoriti emocionalne veze s ljudima. Ne mogu osjetiti tuđe emocije i ne kajem se ni za što. Zašto? Je li to zato što dobivam PTSP zbog sitnica? Nisam imala traumu u djetinjstvu, niti sam je uopće imala. Znam da se puno ljutim, ali ostale moje emocije su "plitke"; u nedostatku boljih riječi. Je li to zato što sam otuđena? Imam i te erotske fantazije koje imam cijeli život. Za mene nisu uznemirujuće. U njima jako uživam, ali ne želim ići u zatvor. I ovaj dio bi mogao biti povezan s PTSP-om, ali ne znam. Ne čujem ni glasove. Dakle, mislite li da je uopće moguće da imam PTSP?
en_back: I think I have symptoms. I've known my whole life that I'm an empath and I still kind of believe it, but what I've found is that I can't form emotional connections with people. I can't feel other people's emotions and I don't regret anything. Why? Is it because I get PTSD over little things? I didn't have any childhood trauma, nor have I ever had any. I know I get angry a lot, but my other emotions are "shallow"; for lack of a better word. Is it because I'm alienated? I also have these erotic fantasies that I've had my whole life. They're not disturbing to me. I really enjoy them, but I don't want to go to jail. And this part could be related to PTSD, but I don't know. I don't hear voices either. So do you think it's even possible that I have PTSD?

en: From the U.S.: I’ve been in therapy and taken many different medications for close to 30 years. In the last 8-9 months my MDD has become medication resistant and is worse than I ever thought possible. I’ve tried ECT (3 treatments) and it did not help at all. I’m doing a litany of self-help wellness things that have taken over my entire life and I’m just getting worse. I take Effexor, Adderal & Clonapin. I do yoga, meditate daily, swim 2-3 times a week, see a therapist weekly, eat very nutritionally, get plenty of sleep but not too much,
hr: Iz SAD-a: Već gotovo 30 godina idem na terapiju i uzimam mnogo različitih lijekova. U posljednjih 8-9 mjeseci moj veliki depresivni poremećaj (MDD) postao je otporan na lijekove i gori je nego što sam ikada mislila da je moguće. Pokušala sam s elektrokonvulzivnom terapijom (3 tretmana) i uopće nije pomoglo. Radim niz stvari za samopomoć koje su mi preuzele cijeli život i stanje mi se samo pogoršava. Uzimam Effexor, Adderal i Clonapin. Bavim se jogom, meditiram svakodnevno, plivam 2-3 puta tjedno, idem terapeutu tjedno, jedem vrlo hranjivo, spavam puno, ali ne previše.
en_back: From the USA: I have been in therapy for almost 30 years and on many different medications. In the last 8-9 months my major depressive disorder (MDD) has become drug resistant and worse than I ever thought possible. I have tried electroconvulsive therapy (3 treatments) and it has not helped at all. I am doing a series of self-help things that have taken over my life and my condition is only getting worse. I am taking Effexor, Adderall and Clonapin. I do yoga, meditate daily, swim 2-3 times a week, see a therapist weekly, eat very nutritiously, get plenty of sleep but not too much.

en: A loved one is suffering from mutism since experiencing a traumatic event. She is not talking at all. Not to family. Not to anyone. I have been looking online and it seems selective mutism is an anxiety problem. She is also listless, does not engage in activities that she normally has before this, does not eat or sleep well, and seems distressed when she has to leave the house or be without the company of a family member. What is the best course of action to getting her back to her old self and over this issue? I think therapy might help but not if she is not talking. I also do not want to make her talk if she is not ready to talk but this is not normal. Thanks for your time.
hr: Voljena osoba pati od mutizma otkako je doživjela traumatični događaj. Uopće ne razgovara. Ni s obitelji. Ni s kim. Tražila sam na internetu i čini se da je selektivni mutizam problem s anksioznošću. Također je bezvoljna, ne bavi se aktivnostima koje je inače radila prije, ne jede i ne spava dobro te se čini uznemireno kada mora napustiti kuću ili biti bez društva člana obitelji. Koji je najbolji postupak da se vrati staroj verziji sebe i prevlada ovaj problem? Mislim da bi terapija mogla pomoći, ali ne ako ne razgovara. Također je ne želim tjerati da govori ako nije spremna razgovarati, ali to nije normalno. Hvala na vašem vremenu.
en_back: My loved one has been suffering from mutism since experiencing a traumatic event. She doesn't talk at all. Not to her family. Not to anyone. I've been looking online and it seems that selective mutism is an anxiety issue. She's also listless, not doing the activities she used to do, not eating or sleeping well, and seems anxious when she has to leave the house or be without a family member. What's the best course of action to get her back to her old self and overcome this problem? I think therapy could help, but not if she won't talk. I also don't want to force her to talk if she's not ready to talk, but that's not normal. Thank you for your time.

en: From France: I work as a teaching assistant at the university. I have a mentor who I assist and who also should be my dissertation mentor. Because nothing I did was ever good enough we decided together that I should seek for a new mentor. I had immediate success and my thesis was confirmed very quickly, even praised by an eminent scholar.
hr: Iz Francuske: Radim kao asistent u nastavi na sveučilištu. Imam mentora kojem pomažem i koji bi trebao biti i moj mentor za disertaciju. Budući da ništa što sam napravio nikada nije bilo dovoljno dobro, zajedno smo odlučili da bih trebao potražiti novog mentora. Odmah sam imao uspjeha i moj je rad vrlo brzo potvrđen, čak ga je pohvalio i jedan eminentni znanstvenik.
en_back: From France: I work as a teaching assistant at a university. I have a mentor who I assist and who should also be my dissertation mentor. Since nothing I have ever done has ever been good enough, we decided together that I should look for a new mentor. I had immediate success and my work was quickly validated, even praised by an eminent scientist.

en: Lately I haven’t been feeling like myself… It’s like I’m more depressed than I normally am. I have always had depression, ever since I was in 7th grade. I would deal with it by cutting myself, and I have been wanting to do it again for no reason. I have caused numerous scratches, not actual cuts. I’ve been battling with myself. I do not sleep much, and when I do sleep it is for at least 10 hours. I have also had a few suicide attempts in the past… And lately I keep thinking about them and remembering them. I don’t want to be around anyone, but then I do, but then I don’t again. When I’m around my friends I feel as though I’m not there. I’m just watching me from the inside, like I’m a soul in a machine. I keep on having nightmares, and dreams about places I’ve never been to… But then a few days later I’ll be at the place I dreamed about. I don’t what’s wrong with me… I was wondering if you could give me a suggestion on what I should do, or what is possibly wrong with me. I feel sick.
hr: U posljednje vrijeme se ne osjećam kao ja... Kao da sam depresivniji nego inače. Oduvijek sam imao depresiju, još od 7. razreda. Nosio bih se s tim porezanjima i bez razloga to želim ponoviti. Nanio sam si brojne ogrebotine, ne prave posjekotine. Borim se sam sa sobom. Ne spavam puno, a kad i spavam, to je barem 10 sati. Imao sam i nekoliko pokušaja samoubojstva u prošlosti... I u posljednje vrijeme stalno razmišljam o njima i sjećam ih se. Ne želim biti ni u čijoj blizini, ali onda spavam, a onda opet ne. Kad sam s prijateljima, osjećam se kao da nisam tamo. Samo se promatram iznutra, kao da sam duša u stroju. Stalno imam noćne more i sanjam o mjestima na kojima nikad nisam bio... Ali onda nekoliko dana kasnije budem na mjestu o kojem sam sanjao. Ne znam što nije u redu sa mnom... Zanima me možete li mi dati prijedlog što bih trebao učiniti ili što je možda u redu sa mnom. Osjećam se loše.
en_back: Lately I haven't been feeling like myself... Like I'm more depressed than usual. I've always had depression, since 7th grade. I would deal with these cuts and for no reason I want to do it again. I've given myself numerous scrapes, not real cuts. I'm struggling with myself. I don't sleep much, and when I do, it's at least 10 hours. I've also had a few suicide attempts in the past... And lately I've been thinking about them all the time and remembering them. I don't want to be around anyone, but then I sleep, and then I don't. When I'm with friends, I feel like I'm not there. I just watch myself from the inside, like I'm a soul in a machine. I keep having nightmares and dreaming about places I've never been... But then a few days later I'm in the place I dreamed about. I don't know what's wrong with me... I was wondering if you could give me a suggestion on what I should do or what might be wrong with me. I feel bad.

en: From a young woman in Bangladesh: My mother was never really happy with my father tho he is a real gentleman and treats her fairy well. He is always beside her when she’s ill and tries his best to support her yet my mother involved in extramarital relationship more than once. When I was a kid, I saw my mother with my own uncle (youngest brother of my father) sharing the bed while my father was out of the city. Often when my dad went outside the city, my uncle came to our house and it was never ok for me even being a very little kid, I could sense well that they’re doing something really immoral.
hr: Od mlade žene iz Bangladeša: Moja majka nikada nije bila baš sretna s mojim ocem iako je on pravi gospodin i dobro se odnosi prema svojoj vili. Uvijek je uz nju kad je bolesna i trudi se najbolje što može da je podrži, no moja je majka više puta bila u izvanbračnoj vezi. Kad sam bila dijete, vidjela sam majku s mojim ujakom (najmlađim bratom moga oca) kako dijele krevet dok je moj otac bio izvan grada. Često kada bi moj tata otišao izvan grada, moj ujak bi došao k nama kući i nikada nije bilo u redu za mene, čak ni kao vrlo malo dijete, dobro sam osjećala da rade nešto stvarno nemoralno.
en_back: From a young woman from Bangladesh: My mother was never very happy with my father even though he is a real gentleman and treats his wife well. He is always there for her when she is sick and tries his best to support her, but my mother has had several extramarital affairs. When I was a child, I saw my mother and my uncle (my father's youngest brother) sharing a bed while my father was out of town. Often when my dad would go out of town, my uncle would come to our house and it was never okay for me, even as a very young child, I felt good that they were doing something really immoral.

en: I am having an impossible time with my 6-year-old daughter. She lies, is defiant, occasionally violent, and occasionally, nearly impossible to be around. From the minute she wakes up in the morning she starts challenging us and I really don’t know what to do. I’m concerned for her safety and well being and don’t know where to get help.
hr: Nevjerojatno se slažem sa svojom šestogodišnjom kćeri. Laže, prkosna je, povremeno nasilna, a ponekad je gotovo nemoguće biti u njenom društvu. Od trenutka kada se ujutro probudi počinje nas izazivati i stvarno ne znam što da radim. Zabrinuta sam za njezinu sigurnost i dobrobit i ne znam gdje da potražim pomoć.
en_back: I get along incredibly well with my six-year-old daughter. She lies, she's defiant, she's occasionally violent, and sometimes it's almost impossible to be around her. From the moment she wakes up in the morning she starts challenging us and I really don't know what to do. I'm worried about her safety and well-being and I don't know where to turn for help.

en: Since I started college in a different state than my home, I isolated myself to focus on school; I decided that I would just focus on academics and not socialize. As a result, I have made no friends in college and there are days, and sometimes weeks, that go by where I don’t talk to a single person. What drove me to continue isolating myself like this was the fact that I was doing well academically. However, I started realizing that all this time in isolation forced me to constantly focus on negative thoughts and I saw a significant decrease in my cognitive ability; things I could previously do quickly in high school took a lot longer now. When I entered the fall semester of my sophomore year in college, the coursework really picked up and I saw myself doing poorly on one exam after another; it really took a toll on me and I just became more and more discouraged after each failure. The day I got a 27/100 on an organic chemistry exam was the day that it all went downhill. From this day onward, I don’t feel stress anymore; stress is what previously drove me to get my work done and do well on exams. My brain is preventing me from focusing now, because of how discouraged I have become. I spend hours upon hours studying, but I’m never efficient because I don’t feel stress; this has become a cycle and is really taking a toll on me. I can’t seem to figure out what’s wrong with me.
hr: Budući da sam započeo fakultet u drugoj državi od one u kojoj živim, izolirao sam se kako bih se usredotočio na školu; odlučio sam da ću se usredotočiti samo na akademske aktivnosti i da se neću družiti. Kao rezultat toga, nisam stekao prijatelje na fakultetu i prođu dani, a ponekad i tjedni, u kojima ne razgovaram ni s jednom osobom. Ono što me potaknulo da se nastavim ovako izolirati bila je činjenica da mi je akademski išlo dobro. Međutim, počeo sam shvaćati da me svo to vrijeme u izolaciji prisiljavalo da se stalno fokusiram na negativne misli i primijetio sam značajan pad svojih kognitivnih sposobnosti; stvari koje sam prije mogao brzo obaviti u srednjoj školi sada su mi trajale puno dulje. Kada sam ušao u jesenski semestar druge godine fakulteta, gradivo se stvarno pojačalo i vidio sam se kako loše prolazim na jednom ispitu za drugim; to me stvarno iscrpilo i postajao sam sve više i više obeshrabren nakon svakog neuspjeha. Dan kada sam dobio 27/100 na ispitu iz organske kemije bio je dan kada je sve krenulo nizbrdo. Od tog dana nadalje više ne osjećam stres; stres me prije tjerao da obavim svoj posao i dobro prođem na ispitima. Moj mozak me sada sprječava da se koncentriram zbog toga koliko sam obeshrabren. Provodim sate i sate učeći, ali nikad nisam učinkovit jer ne osjećam stres; ovo je postao ciklus i stvarno uzima danak na meni. Čini se da ne mogu shvatiti što nije u redu sa mnom.
en_back: Since I started college in a different state than where I live, I isolated myself in order to focus on school; I decided that I would focus only on academics and not socialize. As a result, I didn't make any friends at college and would go days, and sometimes weeks, without talking to anyone. What motivated me to continue isolating myself like this was the fact that I was doing well academically. However, I began to realize that all this time in isolation was forcing me to constantly focus on negative thoughts and I noticed a significant decline in my cognitive abilities; things that I used to be able to do quickly in high school were now taking me much longer. When I entered the fall semester of my sophomore year of college, the material really intensified and I found myself failing one exam after another; it really wore me out and I became more and more discouraged with each failure. The day I got a 27/100 on my organic chemistry exam was the day everything went downhill. From that day forward I no longer feel stressed; stress used to make me want to do my work and do well on exams. My brain now prevents me from concentrating because of how discouraged I am. I spend hours and hours studying but I am never effective because I don't feel stressed; this has become a cycle and it's really taking its toll on me. I can't seem to figure out what's wrong with me.

en: After failed marriage I was in 10 year relationship that now I realize was filled with constant emotional abuse. My self-confidence lowered in time and now I feel like empty shell and completely worthless as human. I am 43 and I see no end of this suffering. I know I should be self-sufficient and love myself and to know how to be happy alone, but I need friends and I need someone to love. During that relationship I lost all friends, and he assured me, he was my best friend. Though I firmly believe he really meant that and he didn’t mean any harm, I also realize that man has serious problems he is not aware of. I ignored all caution signs for 10 years and now I am alone, left and feeling worthless and sad all the time. I can barely work, I am aggressive and sad, I can’t smile or talk.
hr: Nakon propalog braka bila sam u 10-godišnjoj vezi za koju sada shvaćam da je bila ispunjena stalnim emocionalnim zlostavljanjem. Moje samopouzdanje se s vremenom smanjilo i sada se osjećam kao prazna ljuska i potpuno bezvrijedna kao ljudsko biće. Imam 43 godine i ne vidim kraj ovoj patnji. Znam da bih trebala biti samodostatna, voljeti sebe i znati kako biti sretna sama, ali trebaju mi prijatelji i treba mi netko koga ću voljeti. Tijekom te veze izgubila sam sve prijatelje, a on me uvjeravao da mi je najbolji prijatelj. Iako čvrsto vjerujem da je to stvarno mislio i da nije mislio ništa loše, također shvaćam da taj čovjek ima ozbiljnih problema kojih nije svjestan. Ignorirala sam sve znakove opreza 10 godina i sada sam sama, ostavljena i osjećam se bezvrijedno i tužno cijelo vrijeme. Jedva mogu raditi, agresivna sam i tužna, ne mogu se smiješiti ni razgovarati.
en_back: After a failed marriage, I was in a 10-year relationship that I now realize was filled with constant emotional abuse. My self-esteem has eroded over time and I now feel like an empty shell and completely worthless as a human being. I am 43 years old and I see no end to this suffering. I know I should be self-sufficient, love myself and know how to be happy on my own, but I need friends and I need someone to love. During that relationship, I lost all my friends, and he assured me that he was my best friend. While I firmly believe that he really meant it and that he meant no harm, I also realize that this man has serious problems that he is not aware of. I ignored all the warning signs for 10 years and now I am alone, abandoned and feel worthless and sad all the time. I can barely work, I am aggressive and sad, I can't smile or talk.

en: My boyfriend and I have been together for 5 months and it’s really been getting serious and we’re in a long distance relationship. I met his family and friends and they absolutely love me. He met my family and friends and they absolutely love him. Before I met my boyfriend I used to smoke pot on and off. Then I decided to quit and he said “That’s great, but if you were to continue my feelings for you would be the same.” I still quit anyways. Then a few weeks ago I smoked with some friends to relieve the stress in my life and I hadn’t talked to my boyfriend at all that week. So I told him about it because I love him and I tell him everything. When I told him, he flipped out on me and said I was a liar and deceitful and that his opinion of me had lessoned. Then he ended the conversation by saying “I need to think about where we’re going.”
hr: Moj dečko i ja smo zajedno već 5 mjeseci i stvarno je postalo ozbiljno, u vezi smo na daljinu. Upoznala sam njegovu obitelj i prijatelje i oni me apsolutno obožavaju. On je upoznao moju obitelj i prijatelje i oni njega apsolutno obožavaju. Prije nego što sam upoznala dečka, povremeno sam pušila travu. Onda sam odlučila prestati i on je rekao: "To je super, ali da si nastavila gajiti ista osjećanja prema tebi." Ipak sam prestala. Onda sam prije nekoliko tjedana pušila s prijateljima kako bih ublažila stres u svom životu i taj tjedan uopće nisam razgovarala s dečkom. Pa sam mu rekla za to jer ga volim i sve mu govorim. Kad sam mu rekla, naljutio se na mene i rekao da sam lažljivica i prijevarantica te da me je njegovo mišljenje o meni naučilo. Zatim je završio razgovor rekavši: "Moram razmisliti kamo idemo."
en_back: My boyfriend and I have been together for 5 months and it's really gotten serious, we're in a long-distance relationship. I've met his family and friends and they absolutely adore me. He's met my family and friends and they absolutely adore him. Before I met my boyfriend, I used to smoke weed occasionally. Then I decided to quit and he was like, "That's great, but if you still have the same feelings for me." I quit anyway. Then a few weeks ago I smoked with friends to relieve stress in my life and I didn't talk to my boyfriend at all that week. So I told him about it because I love him and I tell him everything. When I told him, he got mad at me and said I was a liar and a cheater and that his opinion of me had taught me. Then he ended the conversation by saying, "I need to think about where we're going."

en: I have recently begun to notice some disturbed thinking I have and I haven’t really been able to talk about. I have had a lot of change happen this last year in every possible area of life but my thinking patterns just seem to be more prominent and I am pretty scared to think where they may lead. I have been in therapy for depression over the last year; but haven’t been able to bring the subject up to my therapist as there are a lot of other issues I am dealing with. I have moved, lost my job, gained a new job, lost friends and mentors, started school again after 10 years, changed career paths, etc. (This could go on for another page) So there always seems to be something to work out or that brings up issues that I want to work on. However, I am afraid that my eating, or habits are harming my overall health.
hr: Nedavno sam počela primjećivati neke poremećene misli o kojima zapravo nisam mogla razgovarati. Puno se toga promijenilo prošle godine u svakom mogućem području života, ali čini se da su moji obrasci razmišljanja jednostavno izraženiji i prilično me strah pomisliti kamo bi mogli dovesti. Posljednjih godinu dana sam bila na terapiji za depresiju, ali nisam mogla o tome razgovarati sa svojim terapeutom jer imam mnogo drugih problema s kojima se suočavam. Preselila sam se, izgubila posao, dobila novi posao, izgubila prijatelje i mentore, ponovno krenula u školu nakon 10 godina, promijenila karijeru itd. (Ovo bi se moglo nastaviti na još jednoj stranici.) Dakle, čini se da uvijek postoji nešto na čemu treba poraditi ili što pokreće probleme na kojima želim poraditi. Međutim, bojim se da moje prehrambene navike ili navike štete mom cjelokupnom zdravlju.
en_back: Recently I started noticing some disturbing thoughts that I couldn't really talk about. A lot has changed in the past year in every possible area of my life, but it seems like my thought patterns are just more pronounced and it's quite scary to think about where they might lead. I've been in therapy for depression for the past year, but I haven't been able to talk about it with my therapist because I have so many other issues I'm dealing with. I've moved, lost my job, got a new job, lost friends and mentors, gone back to school after 10 years, changed careers, etc. (This could go on for another page.) So it seems like there's always something that needs to be worked on or that's triggering issues that I want to work on. However, I'm afraid that my eating habits or habits are harming my overall health.

en: I have never been a ‘feelings person’ and I rarely feel or show strong emotion. I am a teenaged girl so I expected to get a bit teary or whatever. I feel like a lot of the time I only respond to things because I know I am supposed to. like crying a funeral or showing remorse if I did something wrong. But it is strange because I have a natural ability to sense people’s emotions and I have been told I give good advice and I really seem to understand other people’s feelings unless I am personally involved in the situation.
hr: Nikad nisam bila 'osoba koja voli osjećaje' i rijetko osjećam ili pokazujem snažne emocije. Tinejdžerica sam pa sam očekivala da ću malo zaplakati ili tako nešto. Osjećam se kao da često reagiram samo zato što znam da bih trebala. Kao što je plakanje na sprovodu ili pokazivanje kajanja ako sam nešto krivo učinila. Ali čudno je jer imam prirodnu sposobnost osjećanja emocija ljudi i rečeno mi je da dajem dobre savjete i čini se da stvarno razumijem tuđe osjećaje osim ako nisam osobno uključena u situaciju.
en_back: I've never been a 'feelings person' and I rarely feel or show strong emotions. I'm a teenager so I expected to cry a little or something. I feel like I often react just because I know I should. Like crying at a funeral or showing remorse if I've done something wrong. But it's weird because I have a natural ability to feel people's emotions and I've been told that I give good advice and I seem to really understand other people's feelings unless I'm personally involved in the situation.

en: I am fourteen years old. I’ve been experiencing severe depressive symptoms with terrible suicidal thoughts for weeks now. I have also been experiencing all symptoms of social anxiety since grade five. I can’t stand it. There are many different physical and mental tasks i must repeat in order to ensure the safety of me and others. I seem to always have the urge to break something or kill someone. I overeat way too much. I eat when I’m not hungry. I have gained fifty pounds in the last year. My academic performance is suffering. Suicide seems like the best option now. I’ll be starting my plan soon. I feel so trapped!
hr: Imam četrnaest godina. Već tjednima imam teške depresivne simptome sa strašnim suicidalnim mislima. Također imam sve simptome socijalne anksioznosti od petog razreda. Ne mogu to podnijeti. Moram ponavljati mnogo različitih fizičkih i mentalnih zadataka kako bih osigurala svoju i tuđu sigurnost. Čini mi se da uvijek imam poriv nešto razbiti ili nekoga ubiti. Previše se prejedam. Jedem kad nisam gladna. Dobila sam dvadeset i pet kilograma u posljednjih godinu dana. Moj akademski uspjeh pati. Samoubojstvo se sada čini kao najbolja opcija. Uskoro ću započeti sa svojim planom. Osjećam se tako zarobljeno!
en_back: I am fourteen years old. I have been having severe depressive symptoms for weeks with terrible suicidal thoughts. I also have all the symptoms of social anxiety since fifth grade. I can't stand it. I have to repeat many different physical and mental tasks to ensure my own safety and the safety of others. I always seem to have the urge to break something or kill someone. I overeat. I eat when I'm not hungry. I have gained fifty pounds in the last year. My academic performance is suffering. Suicide now seems like the best option. I will start my plan soon. I feel so trapped!

en: Hello, I have not been diagnosed for having ADD since I have not made an appointment yet. I am quiet and shy person who have difficulty in focus. I have a short-term focus that I could not even focus when people talk to me. I am struggling with finishing my assignments although I started it early. It ended up finishing in the last minute which is quite messy.I daydreaming and procrastinating a lot. I tried so hard to concentrate but it was difficult. sometimes, I cry because I could not focus or listen well. I even could not focus when the professor asked questions during my presentation. I tried to consume gingko so maybe it could help with my focus or my memory, but it doesn’t work on me. am I suffering from ADD?
hr: Poštovani, nije mi dijagnosticiran ADHD jer još nisam zakazao/la termin. Tiha sam i sramežljiva osoba koja ima poteškoća s koncentracijom. Imam kratkotrajnu koncentraciju koju ne mogu ni fokusirati kada mi se ljudi obraćaju. Mučim se sa završavanjem zadaća iako sam ih rano počeo/la. Na kraju su završili u zadnji čas, što je prilično neuredno. Puno sanjarim i odugovlačim. Jako sam se trudio/la koncentrirati, ali bilo je teško. Ponekad plačem jer se nisam mogao/la dobro fokusirati ili slušati. Nisam se mogao/la koncentrirati čak ni kada je profesor postavljao pitanja tijekom moje prezentacije. Pokušao/la sam konzumirati ginko pa bi mi možda mogao pomoći s koncentracijom ili pamćenjem, ali ne djeluje na mene. Patim li od ADHD-a?
en_back: Hello, I have not been diagnosed with ADHD because I have not yet made an appointment. I am a quiet and shy person who has difficulty concentrating. I have a short attention span and cannot even focus when people talk to me. I struggle to finish my homework even though I started it early. I end up finishing it at the last minute, which is quite messy. I daydream and procrastinate a lot. I tried really hard to concentrate, but it was difficult. Sometimes I cry because I couldn't focus or listen well. I couldn't even concentrate when the professor asked questions during my presentation. I tried taking ginkgo, thinking it might help with my concentration or memory, but it doesn't work for me. Do I have ADHD?

en: From the UK: We have a new son, now 9 months who is lovely. Most of the time I am absolutely fine. But regularly I feel depressed, I comfort eat, I feel that I am being a terrible father, I feel that I am not supporting my family correctly and feel extremely guilty for having these feelings. I am finding it very difficult to enjoy any element of my life. One of the most upsetting elements is the strain having our baby has put on my wife and my relationship. I also am becoming angry far quicker than I ever have. I guess I am really after a little advice for coping. Many thanks.
hr: Iz Ujedinjenog Kraljevstva: Imamo sina, sada ima 9 mjeseci i prekrasan je. Većinom sam potpuno dobro. Ali redovito se osjećam depresivno, jedem tješivo, osjećam se kao užasan otac, osjećam da ne uzdržavam svoju obitelj kako treba i osjećam se izuzetno krivim zbog tih osjećaja. Vrlo mi je teško uživati u bilo kojem aspektu svog života. Jedan od najuznemirujućih elemenata je pritisak koji je naša beba stavila na moju suprugu i moju vezu. Također se ljutim puno brže nego ikad prije. Mislim da mi stvarno treba mali savjet kako se nositi s tim. Puno hvala.
en_back: From the UK: We have a son, he is now 9 months old and he is beautiful. I am completely fine for the most part. But I feel depressed regularly, I eat comfort food, I feel like a terrible father, I feel like I am not providing for my family properly and I feel extremely guilty about these feelings. I find it very difficult to enjoy any aspect of my life. One of the most upsetting elements is the pressure our baby has put on my wife and our relationship. I also get angry much more quickly than I ever did before. I think I really need some advice on how to deal with this. Thanks a lot.

en: From a 14 year old girl in the U.S.: I’ve been distancing myself from everyone lately, I do it as some sort of defense mechanism I suppose. As a child my father abused me emotionally, lied compulsively and forced me to have trust issues. I’ve always felt alone in life, I’m an older child so my parents aren’t that attentive to me. When they are, I don’t like it. I feel like I shouldn’t have the attention.
hr: Od 14-godišnje djevojčice iz SAD-a: U posljednje vrijeme se distanciram od svih, pretpostavljam da je to neka vrsta obrambenog mehanizma. Kao dijete me otac emocionalno zlostavljao, kompulzivno lagao i prisiljavao me da imam problema s povjerenjem. Uvijek sam se osjećala usamljeno u životu, starije sam dijete pa moji roditelji nisu toliko pažljivi prema meni. Kad jesu, to mi se ne sviđa. Osjećam se kao da ne bih trebala imati tu pažnju.
en_back: From a 14-year-old girl from the US: I've been distancing myself from everyone lately, I guess it's some kind of defense mechanism. As a child, my father emotionally abused me, lied compulsively, and forced me to have trust issues. I've always felt alone in my life, I'm an older child, so my parents don't pay that much attention to me. When they do, I don't like it. I feel like I shouldn't have that attention.

en: I have taken antidepressants for 12 years but I just feel numb. I started taking Paxil 20 mg daily 11 yrs ago when my little brother committed suicide. We were very close. Then my Mom died 6 months later from cancer. Then 2-1/2 months after Mom died, my Dad committed suicide. I increased it to 30mg a few years later when my husband of 9 yrs left me because he couldn’t handle my being depressed. He acted very differently towards me after this all happened. He was never supportive or compassionate, instead he was abusive and cruel. I am still having a lot of trouble getting over this.
hr: Uzimam antidepresive već 12 godina, ali osjećam se jednostavno utrnulo. Počela sam uzimati Paxil 20 mg dnevno prije 11 godina kada je moj mlađi brat počinio samoubojstvo. Bili smo jako bliski. Onda je moja mama umrla 6 mjeseci kasnije od raka. Zatim, 2 i pol mjeseca nakon što je mama umrla, moj tata je počinio samoubojstvo. Povećala sam dozu na 30 mg nekoliko godina kasnije kada me ostavio suprug, s kojim sam bila 9 godina, jer nije mogao podnijeti moju depresiju. Ponašao se vrlo drugačije prema meni nakon svega što se dogodilo. Nikada nije bio podržavajući ili suosjećajan, umjesto toga bio je nasilan i okrutan. Još uvijek imam puno problema s time.
en_back: I've been on antidepressants for 12 years, but I just feel numb. I started taking Paxil 20 mg a day 11 years ago when my younger brother committed suicide. We were very close. Then my mom died 6 months later from cancer. Then, 2 and a half months after my mom died, my dad committed suicide. I increased my dose to 30 mg a few years later when my husband of 9 years left me because he couldn't handle my depression. He treated me very differently after everything that happened. He was never supportive or compassionate, instead he was abusive and cruel. I still have a lot of trouble with it.

en: I’ve been known to help out friends and loved ones that are going through their own trials and tribulations, and I genuinely do love doing this because I know its the right thing to do and it makes me happy to see them find the light at the end of the tunnel per say. But as the years go by I’ve noticed that the same people I’ve helped out seem to either leave me in the dust or I get the feeling they weren’t actually appreciative of me helping them out. Don’t get me wrong, I get that I’m not gonna be the only important thing in their lives but it still really hurts me for them to just drop me off like that when considering the countless hours I’ve spent with them assisting them through their own dilemmas and stretching my olive branch as far as I possibly can. But even then sometimes they would outright ignore my advice or spit it back in my face, only for them to get hurt because they didn’t listen to my advice and by the end of it they come back saying I was right only for them to do the same exact thing and continue their own vicious cycle and it pained me deeply to see them that way. I can even think of moments where one of them would leave me in the dark while vaguely communicating with me leading me to get frustrated and anxious over what in gods name they’d be doing only for them to be completely fine by the end of it. It’s terrible. Plus, every time I’ve tried to get in contact with some of these people now they seem to blow me off as if I never said hello. As a result, I feel hurt, I don’t always think about them but when I do it feels like a dagger in my heart. I feel like I maybe shouldn’t have tried to assist them and maybe I wouldn’t feel like the way I do now. This really shouldn’t bother me as much as it should but this just leads me to feel like I’ve been used and thrown away and as a result I question my own worth or if I should even bother. I’m sorry for the rambling, thank you for your time
hr: Poznata sam po tome što pomažem prijateljima i voljenima koji prolaze kroz vlastite kušnje i nevolje, i iskreno volim to raditi jer znam da je to ispravna stvar i veseli me vidjeti ih kako pronalaze svjetlo na kraju tunela. Ali kako godine prolaze, primjećujem da me isti ljudi kojima sam pomogla ili ostavljaju u prašini ili imam osjećaj da zapravo nisu bili zahvalni što sam im pomogla. Nemojte me krivo shvatiti, razumijem da neću biti jedina važna stvar u njihovim životima, ali i dalje me jako boli što me samo tako ostavljaju kad uzmem u obzir bezbroj sati koje sam provela s njima pomažući im u njihovim vlastitim dilemama i pružajući im svoju maslinovu grančicu koliko god mogu. Ali čak i tada bi ponekad potpuno ignorirali moj savjet ili mi ga uzvratili u lice, samo da bi se povrijedili jer ga nisu poslušali i na kraju bi se vratili govoreći da sam bila u pravu samo da bi oni učinili istu stvar i nastavili svoj vlastiti začarani krug i duboko me boljelo vidjeti ih takvima. Mogu se čak sjetiti trenutaka kada bi me netko od njih ostavio u mraku dok bi nejasno komunicirao sa mnom, što bi me navelo da postanem frustrirana i tjeskobna zbog onoga što će, za ime Božje, učiniti samo da bi na kraju bili potpuno dobro. Strašno je. Osim toga, svaki put kada pokušam stupiti u kontakt s nekim od tih ljudi sada, čini se da me ignoriraju kao da ih nikad nisam ni pozdravila. Kao rezultat toga, osjećam se povrijeđeno, ne mislim uvijek na njih, ali kada mislim, osjećam se kao bodež u srcu. Osjećam se kao da možda nisam trebala pokušati pomoći im i možda se ne bih osjećala onako kako se sada osjećam. Ovo me stvarno ne bi trebalo toliko smetati koliko bi trebalo, ali zbog ovoga se osjećam kao da sam iskorištena i odbačena, te zbog toga preispitujem vlastitu vrijednost ili da li se uopće trebam truditi. Žao mi je što brbljam, hvala vam na vremenu.
en_back: I'm known for helping friends and loved ones who are going through their own trials and tribulations, and I genuinely love doing it because I know it's the right thing to do and it makes me happy to see them find the light at the end of the tunnel. But as the years go by, I find that the same people I've helped either leave me in the dust or I feel like they weren't really grateful for my help. Don't get me wrong, I understand that I won't be the only important thing in their lives, but it still hurts so much to be left like that when I consider the countless hours I've spent with them helping them with their own dilemmas and extending my olive branch to them as much as I can. But even then, sometimes they would completely ignore my advice or throw it back in my face, only to get hurt because they didn't listen to it and end up coming back saying I was right only for them to do the same thing and continue their own vicious cycle, and it hurt me deeply to see them like that. I can even remember times when one of them would leave me in the dark while communicating vaguely with me, causing me to become frustrated and anxious about what on earth they were going to do just to make sure they were completely fine. It's horrible. Also, every time I try to contact one of these people now, they seem to ignore me as if I never even said hello. As a result, I feel hurt, I don't always think about them, but when I do, it feels like a dagger in my heart. I feel like maybe I shouldn't have tried to help them and maybe I wouldn't be feeling the way I am now. This really shouldn't bother me as much as it should, but it makes me feel used and rejected, and it makes me question my own worth or whether I should even bother. I'm sorry for rambling, thank you for your time.

en: From England: I am the youngest out of 2 sisters and 3 brothers. I have always supported my family members and been there for them whether when my sister went through depression when she lost her job or when my brother became a drug addict. I help each and one of them on their weddings and spent at least £2000 in each wedding. I am now getting married [redacted] of August and I just realized that my dad is not coming, my sister is not coming, my brother is not coming and my second brother said he is coming and does not want to help in the wedding at all. My best man who I have known for 15 years has just told me he can’t come to my wedding because of his job even though I have been telling him to book his holiday from one year and he has been slacking off and maybe doesn’t want to come in person. All I have coming is my mum and sister. I don’t have a lot of friends. I cannot believe this is happening to me. I don’t know why is this happening. After each wedding, I get exhausted because I keep doing chores for 2 weeks for each of my family members and now when my turn comes, they keep giving me these stupid excuses. I am not a horrible person.
hr: Iz Engleske: Najmlađa sam od dvije sestre i tri brata. Uvijek sam podržavala članove svoje obitelji i bila tu za njih, bilo kada je moja sestra prolazila kroz depresiju kada je izgubila posao ili kada je moj brat postao ovisnik o drogama. Pomažem svakome od njih na vjenčanjima i potrošila sam najmanje 2000 funti na svako vjenčanje. Sada se udajem za [uređeno] u kolovozu i upravo sam shvatila da moj tata ne dolazi, moja sestra ne dolazi, moj brat ne dolazi, a moj drugi brat je rekao da dolazi i da uopće ne želi pomoći na vjenčanju. Moj kum, kojeg poznajem 15 godina, upravo mi je rekao da ne može doći na moje vjenčanje zbog posla iako mu već godinu dana govorim da rezervira svoj odmor, a on se opušta i možda ne želi doći osobno. Dolaze mi samo mama i sestra. Nemam puno prijatelja. Ne mogu vjerovati da mi se ovo događa. Ne znam zašto se ovo događa. Nakon svakog vjenčanja se iscrpim jer dva tjedna obavljam kućanske poslove za svakog člana obitelji, a sada kada dođe moj red, stalno mi daju te glupe izgovore. Nisam užasna osoba.
en_back: From England: I am the youngest of two sisters and three brothers. I have always supported my family members and been there for them, whether it was when my sister was going through depression when she lost her job or when my brother became addicted to drugs. I help with each of their weddings and have spent at least £2000 on each wedding. I am getting married to [edited] in August and I have just realised that my dad is not coming, my sister is not coming, my brother is not coming and my other brother has said he is coming and he doesn't want to help with the wedding at all. My best man, who I have known for 15 years, has just told me that he can't come to my wedding because of work even though I have been telling him to book his own holiday for a year and he is relaxing and may not want to come in person. Only my mum and sister are coming. I don't have many friends. I can't believe this is happening to me. I don't know why this is happening. After every wedding I get exhausted because I spend two weeks doing housework for every family member, and now when it's my turn, they keep giving me these stupid excuses. I'm not a terrible person.

en: From a teen in the U.S.: i don’t know what this is or if there is a technical term from it. i suffer from ptsd, anxiety, depression and ocd. so basically i have been pregnant twice, once with a miscarriage and once with my son who is now almost 3 months. basically both times in early pregnancy, i have this weird sensation. idk how to describe it. i get this feeling in my head and feel sick, gross, nervous etc. both the beginning of my pregnancies were rough with sickness. anytime i think back to then i feel the weird feeling i had then. i don’t even know if i’m making sense. i felt this feeling throughout my pregnancy and then when i had my son it stopped. but when i think of it i get nervous and get the feeling if they makes any sense. lately i’ve been feeling sick, tired, headaches, nausea. and the feeling the i got in the beggining of my other pregnancies. but, i don’t think i’m pregnant but i’m scared i am because of the feeling and it’s giving me major anxiety.
hr: Od tinejdžerice iz SAD-a: ne znam što je ovo ili postoji li neki tehnički izraz za to. Patim od PTSP-a, anksioznosti, depresije i opsesivno-kompulzivnog poremećaja. Dakle, u osnovi sam bila dva puta trudna, jednom s spontanim pobačajem i jednom sa sinom koji je sada skoro 3 mjeseca. Uglavnom, oba puta u ranoj trudnoći imam taj čudan osjećaj. Ne znam kako bih ga opisala. Imam taj osjećaj u glavi i osjećam se mučno, odvratno, nervozno itd. Oba početka moje trudnoće bila su teška s mučninama. Kad god se sjetim tada, osjetim taj čudan osjećaj koji sam tada imala. Ne znam ni imam li smisla. Osjećala sam taj osjećaj tijekom cijele trudnoće, a onda, kada sam rodila sina, prestao je. Ali kad pomislim na to, postanem nervozna i dobijem osjećaj ima li to ikakvog smisla. U posljednje vrijeme osjećam se mučno, umorno, imam glavobolje, mučninu. I osjećaj koji sam imala na početku drugih trudnoća. Ali, ne mislim da sam trudna, ali me strah da jesam zbog tog osjećaja i to mi uzrokuje veliku tjeskobu.
en_back: From a teenager in the US: I don't know what this is or if there's a technical term for it. I suffer from PTSD, anxiety, depression, and obsessive-compulsive disorder. So basically I've been pregnant twice, once with a miscarriage and once with my son who is now almost 3 months old. Basically, both times in early pregnancy I have this weird feeling. I don't know how to describe it. I have this feeling in my head and I feel sick, disgusting, nervous, etc. Both early pregnancies were difficult with nausea. Whenever I think back to that time, I get that weird feeling I had back then. I don't even know if it makes sense. I had this feeling throughout my pregnancy, and then when I had my son, it stopped. But when I think about it, I get nervous and I get a feeling like it makes no sense. Lately I've been feeling nauseous, tired, have headaches, nausea. And the feeling I had at the beginning of other pregnancies. But, I don't think I'm pregnant, but I'm afraid I am because of that feeling and it's causing me a lot of anxiety.

en: I’m 23 years old, I’m finishing my studies, and I’ve been in a relationship for 2 years. My parents never wanted to know him cause he isn’t the looking good type, that they imagined to me (cause he is bald, without status and money). However he’s a nice independent man (he got his own house and car) with 28 years old, I love him, he is very honest and kind to me. He always treated me well and despite my parent’s attempts to separate us.
hr: Imam 23 godine, završavam studij i u vezi sam već 2 godine. Moji roditelji ga nikada nisu htjeli upoznati jer nije bio onakav dobar tip kakvim su me zamišljali (jer je ćelav, bez statusa i novca). Međutim, on je drag i neovisan muškarac (ima vlastitu kuću i auto) sa 28 godina, volim ga, vrlo je iskren i ljubazan prema meni. Uvijek se dobro ponašao prema meni, unatoč pokušajima mojih roditelja da nas razdvoje.
en_back: I'm 23 years old, I'm finishing my studies and I've been in a relationship for 2 years. My parents never wanted to meet him because he wasn't the good guy they imagined me to be (because he's bald, has no status and no money). However, he's a nice and independent man (he has his own house and car) at 28, I love him, he's very honest and kind to me. He's always treated me well, despite my parents' attempts to break us up.

en: From the U.S.: My house mate has been diagnosed by a psychiatrist with depression and is taking meds. The associated problem from a very untrained point of view is that they have for the first time in their life at 50 realized they can’t have everything they want and life isn’t always fair – and this lesson coming so late has really thrown a curve ball at them.
hr: Iz SAD-a: Moj cimer je kod psihijatra dijagnosticirao depresiju i uzima lijekove. Problem s tim, iz vrlo neobučene perspektive, jest taj što su prvi put u životu s 50 godina shvatili da ne mogu imati sve što žele i da život nije uvijek pravedan – a ova lekcija, koja je došla tako kasno, doista ih je zbunila.
en_back: From the US: My roommate has been diagnosed with depression by a psychiatrist and is on medication. The problem with this, from a very untrained perspective, is that for the first time in their lives, at 50, they realized that they can't have everything they want and that life isn't always fair - and this lesson, coming so late, really confused them.

en: I have been diagnosed with Aspergers and Major Depression, however I am not sure these diagnoses are correct as hypnogogic hallucinations continue and frankly, even after two different types of antidepressants, my depression is only marginally better.
hr: Dijagnosticiran mi je Aspergerov sindrom i velika depresija, međutim nisam siguran jesu li te dijagnoze točne jer hipnogoške halucinacije i dalje postoje i, iskreno, čak i nakon dvije različite vrste antidepresiva, moja depresija je samo neznatno bolja.
en_back: I have been diagnosed with Asperger's syndrome and major depression, however I am not sure if these diagnoses are correct as the hypnogogic hallucinations are still present and, honestly, even after two different types of antidepressants, my depression is only marginally better.

en: From the U.S.: I believe my brother suffers from a severe personality disorder. He is 21 years old. He is extremely aggressive when he doesn’t get his way, he verbally abuses those that are close to him because “we don’t ever help him with anything”. He’s incredibly lazy, refuses to work and uses my parents divorce as an excuse to be “depressed” and miss work.
hr: Iz SAD-a: Mislim da moj brat pati od teškog poremećaja osobnosti. Ima 21 godinu. Iznimno je agresivan kada ne dobije ono što želi, verbalno vrijeđa one koji su mu bliski jer „mu nikada ne pomažemo ni u čemu“. Nevjerojatno je lijen, odbija raditi i koristi razvod mojih roditelja kao izgovor da bude „depresivan“ i izostaje s posla.
en_back: From the USA: I think my brother suffers from a severe personality disorder. He is 21 years old. He is extremely aggressive when he doesn't get what he wants, verbally abuses those close to him because "we never help him with anything". He is incredibly lazy, refuses to work and uses my parents' divorce as an excuse to be "depressed" and miss work.

en: I’m writing for my brother who is currently 26. I am his older brother. I have been concerned about him for a long time. Growing up he had few friends and would mainly play video games by himself or online. Also growing up he was a bit bossy towards my parents and others, he was the youngest child. In college he had a short phase where he was a bit more social. It is now about 4 years since he has graduated college. In that time he has not worked any job. He gets angry when people try to tell him to think about the future and what he wants to do with his life. He lives alone in an apartment that my parents own in Queens (we live on Long Island). He barely goes outside. He orders things to his apartment, even food so he doesnt go outside (he doesn’t know how to drive either). He mainly just plays video games online and sleeps. It seems like he has some hidden form of cash flow that we do not know of since he buys himself things on Amazon quite frequently. He is extremely moody and can get in quite negative angry moods towards others. This has been 4 years and I am not sure what to do. He himself does not seem open for us trying to help, when my parents try to have a more serious talk with him he gets extremely angry and then will say extreme things to get them to stop talking, like “This will be the last you will ever see me. I will move to Sweden” (he is currently dating a girl online from Sweden who has recently come to visit him in NY). Or he will even say things like committing suicide if we try to get involved help him. We do not want him to run away to Sweden so we are not sure what to do as we feel like we are walking on thin ice over here. But he has been stuck for so long. The problem is that he doesn’t seem to care at all. I wasn’t sure what to do and would appreciate your help on how to hopefully get things on a positive path. We do not want to see him waste away his life like this any longer. What is the first step? Thank you.
hr: Pišem za svog brata koji trenutno ima 26 godina. Ja sam njegov stariji brat. Dugo sam zabrinut za njega. Odrastao je s malo prijatelja i uglavnom je igrao videoigre sam ili online. Također, odrastao je pomalo šefovski prema mojim roditeljima i drugima, bio je najmlađe dijete. Na fakultetu je imao kratko razdoblje kada je bio malo društveniji. Sada je prošlo oko 4 godine otkako je diplomirao na fakultetu. U tom vremenu nije radio nikakav posao.
